listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Nuit Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: The Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Nuit Eau de Parfum Spray turns day into night - in a charming, sensual way! Experience precious moments with the perfume that emphasises your femininity and brings out your mysterious side. Bronze Goddess Nuit is your reliable companion for romantic dinners under the stars as well as for a break in the middle of the day. Magical and enchanting Spicy, even slightly smoky, but still exuding pure femininity with a hint of flowers: this is how the Eau de Parfum Spray by Estée Lauder can be aptly described. The mystical side of this exquisite fragrance is omnipresent and transports you to a world full of magic. Experience marvellous sunsets or the view of the stars, even if only during a short dream journey in everyday life. The fragrance nuances of Bronze Goddess Nuit are very versatile and start with sweet bergamot and exotic ylang-ylang. A peppery accord keeps the perfume interesting and exciting. A bouquet of flowers then unfolds, accompanied by coconut, which reminds you of faraway destinations in places like the Caribbean. Enjoy your personal everyday time-out again and again - with the fragrance from Estée Lauder!

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: The Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Eau de Parfum brings a summery fragrance experience directly into everyday life. The fragrance is presented in an elegant glass bottle with a rose gold colour gradient and a metallic, grooved cap. The warm composition envelops the body with a harmonious blend of sunny notes that immediately evoke carefree holidays. Thanks to the fine formulation as an eau de parfum, the aroma is long-lasting and reliably accompanies you throughout the day. A quick spray in the morning is enough to create a pleasant and present aura, allowing for economical consumption. This makes the perfume an uncomplicated companion for a variety of situations, whether at work, in your free time or for a special occasion in the evening. The carefully coordinated fragrance accords blend gently with each other and leave an elegant, warm impression. Anyone wearing this fragrance will enjoy a carefree olfactory signature that skilfully captures the feeling of warm sunshine and subtly emphasises personal charisma. Long-lasting fragrance experience thanks to the concentrated formulation as an eau de parfum Warm, summery fragrance composition for a daily holiday feeling Versatile use for leisure, work and evening occasions Easy and economical application thanks to the fine spray head

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The seductive warmth of sun-kissed skin, the refreshing sea breeze and the interplay of fruity and floral notes of lush nature. Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue embodies the carefree mood of a day accompanied by the soothing sound of the waves gently lapping against the rocks of Capri. THE DESIGN Simple sophistication down to the smallest detail: the bottle with its soft contours has a matt finish and elegant silver-coloured elements. It is crowned by an enamelled, sky-blue cap, the design of which is inspired by the traditional ceramics of the Amalfi Coast, enhanced by the characteristic DG monogram.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Parfum brings a refreshing fragrance composition to everyday life. A minimalist glass bottle with a light blue cap and subtle gold details encases the fine essence. Sparkling citrus notes unfold immediately after spraying and can create an invigorating feeling for the start of the day. Fruity accents combine harmoniously with delicate floral aromas, giving the fragrance a pleasant lightness. This balanced blend is ideal for warm days or everyday use in the office, as it remains present without being overpowering. The woody base note rounds off the fragrance experience and leaves a soft, warm presence on the skin. A few sprays on pulse points such as the wrists or neck are enough to optimally unfold the aromas. The creation discreetly accompanies you through various everyday situations and conveys a lasting feeling of freshness. Refreshing fragrance composition with sparkling citrus notes and delicate floral aromas Versatile use for everyday office life and warm summer days Woody base note for a soft, warm presence on the skin Easy to use thanks to targeted spraying on the pulse points Minimalist glass bottle with elegant blue and gold details

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue pour homme Eau de Parfum Spray Capri in Love 50 ml
listings.description: A breath of salty sea air and the warm, golden light of Capri invite you to dream. Light Blue Capri In Love Pour Homme Eau de Parfum unfolds in a fascinating and flattering way, opening with the spicy freshness of black pepper. The heart reveals the lively, green essence of the Capri fig, while precious patchouli lends the fragrance depth and a magnetic elegance, symbolising the Mediterranean flair of the island. THE DESIGN The bottle with its flowing contours and enamelled cap is adorned with ornate patterns reminiscent of Capri's traditional blue majolica tiles, a design that reflects the beauty of the island in every detail.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray My Devotion 30 ml
listings.description: With Dolce&Gabbana My Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense, you will discover a harmonious fragrance composition that enriches your everyday life with floral, fruity notes. The top note of delicate pear blossom and blackcurrant opens the experience and offers you a refreshing moment to start the day. Orange blossom and peony then unfold their floral accents, elegantly emphasising your charisma for every occasion. The base of ambroxan, warm Madagascar vanilla and amber rounds off the creation and leaves a long-lasting, gourmand presence on the skin that will accompany you reliably into the evening. Master perfumer Olivier Cresp created this intense fragrance as an expression of authenticity, making it ideal to wear as your daily signature perfume. This composition is encased in a shiny pink bottle with an ornate golden heart emblem. listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One For Men Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: This eau de parfum, launched in 2015, is a deeper and denser interpretation of the classic fragrance concept. Designed by Olivier Polge, the composition is characterised by a higher concentration of fragrance oils, which ensures a long-lasting fragrance experience. The opening is characterised by a combination of grapefruit, coriander and basil, which conveys an aromatic yet elegant freshness. As the fragrance progresses, a spicy heart unfolds, in which striking notes of ginger and cardamom meet the subtle nuance of orange blossom. These elements finally merge into a persistent base characterised by accords of tobacco, amber and cedar wood, giving the perfume its woody character. The design of the bottle emphasises the value of the contents: A heavy, rectangular glass body reveals the brown liquid and is topped with a colour-coordinated, dark brown cap. The clear, geometric lines are only accentuated by a silver inscription on the front, which completes the overall aesthetic look. Fragrance: Warm and spicy with woody and aromatic elements Head note: A fresh blend of grapefruit, coriander and basil. Heart note: Spicy accents of ginger and cardamom as well as orange blossom. Base note: Deep accords of tobacco, amber and cedarwood. Design: Rectangular glass bottle with brown contents and dark brown cap.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Only One captures the essence of elegant, mesmerising femininity. This composition impresses with a modern combination of violet and coffee notes. Like the woman it represents, the fragrance is a complex interplay of contrasts. This beguiling creation draws its special charm from the unexpected mocha violet note. The violet opens up the fragrance and combines with subtle notes of bergamot to create a lively, fresh and juicy bouquet. A harmonious whole emerges in the heart note with the fusion of seductive notes of rich coffee and charming iris, while the base delicately envelops the senses with a coating of vanilla and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue pour homme Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Parfum Spray offers an intense fragrance composition that transports you to the vast hilly landscapes of Tuscany. The creation is presented in a clear glass bottle with a light blue lid and subtle gold-coloured accents. The fine atomiser allows you to apply the perfume precisely and evenly to the desired areas of skin. Immediately after application, a fresh note of Sicilian lemon unfolds, providing a pleasant start to the day in the morning. Later on, the fruity nuances of fig combine with the warm, earthy character of Virginian cedarwood to create a well-rounded overall picture. This balanced combination gives you an aura of presence that is suitable for both business and leisure. As this is a highly concentrated eau de parfum, you benefit from a long-lasting fragrance that will reliably accompany you for many hours and makes constant refreshing unnecessary. listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray is an exclusive and extraordinary fragrance that is noble, graceful and luxurious . The name translates as "The Empress". There is therefore no doubt that this is an extravagant perfume that envelops women in a distinguished, aristocratic aura . Fruity-sweet notes meet fresh and floral influences and give every woman a romantic, seductive and extremely attractive aura. A touch of decadence is used here as a playful stylistic device. Modern, decadent and elegant - a fragrance with an aristocratic signature Fruity notes of redcurrant, kiwi and rhubarb open the unmistakable fragrance composition in the top note. The heart note is perfectly complemented by the sounds of pink cyclamen and watermelon. The Dolce&Gabbana L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray is rounded off in the base with accords of grapefruit wood, musk and sandalwood. This is where the fragrance gains its depth and intensity. The perfume was launched back in 2009 and released in a new edition in 2020. Due to its lightness , L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray by Dolce&Gabbana is particularly effective in the warmer seasons.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: K by Dolce&Gabbana A new era of masculinity . In an instant, the warm, cosy embrace of K by Dolce & Gabbana evokes the Italian countryside and the Mediterranean midday sun, evoking the fresh, earthy scent of the wooded Tuscan hills. listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum Intense 30 ml
listings.description: The One Eau de Parfum Intense is a fascinating reinterpretation of the well-known classic. Perfumer Quentin Bisch is responsible for this composition, which combines tried-and-tested elements with new accents. Bright notes of spicy pink pepper meet the freshness of mandarin and the fruitiness of blackcurrant in the opening. At the centre of the creation is a striking jasmine note that gives the fragrance a distinct floral character. This heart note transitions gently into a persistent base. Here, creamy vanilla and rich amber accords come together to create a harmonious finish. This combination creates an aura of opulence and warmth that remains perceptible for several hours. The high-quality content is also reflected visually. A heavy, rectangular bottle made of amber-coloured glass with clear, rounded edges houses the golden liquid. A wide, shiny metallic cap in a gold tone rounds off the design harmoniously. Black letters on the front provide a clear contrast to the warm colour of the glass and underline the modern elegance of the presentation. The eau de parfum is available in different quantities, such as 50 ml or 100 ml, to suit different needs. Intense reinterpretation of the classic fragrance by Quentin Bisch Composition of pink pepper, jasmine, vanilla and amber Rectangular amber-coloured glass bottle with gold accents Available in different sizes such as 50 ml and 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in a world of passion and elegance with the Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray. This intensified version of the popular Devotion fragrance is a tribute to the timeless beauty and power of love. With its unique fragrance composition, this perfume takes you on a sensual journey. Intense perfume for intense moments The fragrance profile opens with an aromatic top note of hazelnut, which immediately captivates your senses. The floral elegance of orange blossom unfolds at the heart of the perfume, lending the fragrance a delicate, feminine note. The base note rounds off the composition with warm, sweet vanilla, which ensures a long-lasting, seductive fragrance. The Eau de Parfum Intense Spray by Dolce&Gabbana is characterised by its particularly concentrated formulation, which ensures a long-lasting fragrance. The elegant bottle with its characteristic golden cap is not only a container for the precious fragrance, but also a real piece of jewellery for your dressing table. To optimise the fragrance, it is recommended to apply the perfume to pulse points such as the wrists, neck and décolleté. It is particularly suitable for special occasions and evening events, but also gives you an aura of luxury and sophistication in everyday life. Let yourself be enchanted by the unique combination of nutty, floral and sweet notes. Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray is more than just a perfume - it is an expression of devotion and elegance that accompanies you throughout the day and emphasises your individual personality.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: With K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum , Dolce&Gabbana Beauty offers a fragrance for men that is as unique as it is sensual . listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Spray Intense 50 ml
listings.description: 2024 sees the launch of the Eau de Parfum Spray Intense K by Dolce&Gabbana. The perfume from Dolce&Gabbana is for men and has a fresh, oriental fragrance . Created by the grand mistress Nathalie Lorson and Daphné Bugey, this perfume only needs three ingredients to develop its casual elegance. Without a fragrance pyramid, the Eau de Parfum Spray Intense K by Dolce&Gabbana blends figs, leather and saffron. Dolce&Gabbana has succeeded in creating an expressive, sensual fragrance for men that is both elegant and casual, perceptible but not overpowering. A true all-rounder with depth Masculine fragrances are often over-present and, especially at work, men prefer to wear a fragrance that doesn't arrive 5 minutes before they do. The Eau de Parfum Spray Intense K by Dolce&Gabbana is just such a fragrance. It accompanies its wearer with a perceptible presence, but without imposing itself. Dolce&Gabbana's perfume is just as perfect for leisure as it is for work, regardless of the season. The stylish, dark blue bottle with a silver crown conceals a perfume that men like to wear and women like to notice on their counterparts. The more intense version of K from 2020 is simply ravishing .

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Dolce Eau de Toilette Spray Lily 75 ml
listings.description: Dolce Lily celebrates the charisma of the pink lily - a symbol of femininity and tenderness since time immemorial. The fragrance is a fresh, fruity, floral composition in which the delicate floral notes of the lily meet exotic passion fruit on a bed of soft, sensual musk. Powerful fruity notes open the composition - the sparkling citrus notes of Italian bergamot play with a touch of tropical passion fruit. This exotic touch leads into the floral heart note, in which sparkling pink lily blends with sophisticated rose tones. The radiance of these flowers contrasts with the soft musky notes that form a subtly sensual accord beneath and behind them. Sandalwood grounds the composition with its own depth, and vanilla tones allow the composition to linger long on the skin. The bottle picks up on the feminine elegance of the original Dolce silhouette, but now dresses in a bold pink, from which the vivacious personality of the Dolce girl shines out into the world. The familiar floral cap comes in the same vibrant pink and anticipates the fresh lily accord of the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Q by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Spray Intense 30 ml
listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana awakens the queen in you ! With Q by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Spray Intense, you can emphasise your feminine and self-confident style. Give your everyday life a royal touch: the perfume combines heliotrope with citrus fruits, sweet fruits and individual flowers as well as a charming base of woods and amber. Who could resist this potpourri? Discover your royal charm with Dolce&Gabbana Experience the diversity of Q by Dolce&Gabbana! The Eau de Parfum Spray Intense is as individual as your look. It starts with a revelation of cherry and citrus fruits, then moves into a heart of heliotrope and cherry and garnishes the whole thing with a hint of jasmine. It is mysterious and almost unapproachable, but the sweetness makes it playful again. In the base, accords such as amber and cedarwood are true classics that prove themselves time and time again. Overall, the different components create a sophisticated, expressive fragrance that skilfully interweaves tradition and modernity. Feel like a queen at every moment with Q by Dolce&Gabbana! This is achieved on the one hand by the fragrance itself and on the other by the royal flacon, which is closed with a crown.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Dolce Eau de Toilette Spray Rose 50 ml
listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana Beauty adds another flower to the Dolce bouquet: DOLCE ROSE. The lively and beguiling eau de toilette shows the world another facet of the Dolce girls. Bold, optimistic and sociable, they say what they think and light up the streets with their feminine spontaneity. Dolce Rose captures this carefree joy in a fragrance that is as powerful and spirited as any Dolce Girl. The first eau de toilette in the Dolce collection, Dolce Rose celebrates the queen of flowers, a symbol of love, beauty and femininity and a signature motif in Dolce&Gabbana's work. Created by master perfumer Violaine Collas, the fragrance combines delicate rose absolute and fresh centifolia notes with soft musk and tangy redcurrant. Full of energy and joie de vivre, Dolce Rose is an irresistibly enchanting composition. Intense fruity top notes open the composition in a triad of fresh green apple, juicy mandarin and tangy redcurrant. In the heart note, white peach appeals to our sense of taste and opens our senses to a floral bouquet of velvety magnolia blossoms and majestic roses. The unique character of the fragrance is created from a composition of two rose notes: The dewy clarity of a centifolia essence combines with the soft sensuality of rose absolute to create an unmistakable rose fragrance. This powerful note is embedded in a mantle of soft musk tones, to which sandalwood and other noble light wood notes lend a beguilingly sensual quality. The bottle shares its soft curves and elegantly feminine silhouette with the original Dolce fragrance, but now dips its glass in a rose-red colour in which the eponymous blossom seems to glow. The unmistakable flower cap is now also dressed in a bold red colour that expresses the personality of the Dolce girl and the fascinating facets of the fragrance.

listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana presents Dolce Blue Jasmine Eau de Parfum, a harmonious composition that combines the sweetness of Sicilian blue fig with the sensual nuances of Arabian jasmine. The fragrance unfolds with the milky and refreshing notes of fig, accompanied by green accents, and plunges into a floral heart of jasmine. A fragrance that embodies optimism and freedom and encourages you to consciously experience every moment.</p

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Fame Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Rabanne Fame Eau de Parfum Spray is a powerful yet sensual women's fragrance that emphasises its wearer's multifaceted nature and uniqueness. The fragrance emphasises the playful, romantic nature of femininity as well as its sensual traits. The perfume is suitable for women who like to express their individuality in an exclusive setting. With Fame Eau de Parfum Spray, the exceptional designer Rabanne succeeds in enveloping every woman in a fascinating and mysterious aura . A sensual fragrance for the exclusive moments in life In the top note, the citrus-fresh lightness of bergamot paired with the sweet fruitiness of tropical mango opens the elegant fragrance experience. The heart note brings out the oriental components of seductive jasmine and smoky, spicy incense. In the base note, the sweetness of vanilla and the aroma of soft sandalwood take the lead. This makes Fame Eau de Parfum Spray by Rabanne an olfactory hymn to femininity that subtly emphasises the different characteristics of women. A sophisticated fragrance for all seasons, which is particularly captivating in the warmer months thanks to its sweetness. The extravagant glass flacon in an eye-catching and opulent design leaves no doubt that this fragrance emphasises the uniqueness of its wearer and skilfully brings it to the fore. A highlight in any bathroom.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Phantom In Red Parfum Elixir 50 ml
listings.description: The Rabanne Phantom In Red Parfum Elixir is an intense reinterpretation of the well-known Phantom line, which is characterised by a high concentration of fragrance oils. This Parfum Elixir unfolds a complex, amber-aromatic and woody profile that picks up on the characteristic lavender note of the series and expands it with unexpected nuances. The opening is a combination of fruity plum liqueur and saffron, which creates a striking first impression. At the heart of the fragrance, classic lavender, sage and orange blossom combine to form a harmonious whole. The composition is rounded off by a warm base of benzoin, tobacco, oud and amberwood, which lends the fragrance depth and longevity. The design of the bottle picks up on the futuristic robot aesthetic and creates visual highlights with red accents and a black dot in a red oval on the top. It is a fragrance that has a multi-layered structure thanks to its earthy and woody facets and the integration of citrus notes such as bergamot oil. Fragrance family: Earthy-woody with amber-aromatic facets. Head notes: Plum liqueur and saffron. Heart notes: Lavender, sage and orange blossom. Base notes: Benzoin, tobacco, oud and amberwood. Special feature: High concentration as a perfume elixir for long-lasting intensity.

listings.description: Born In Roma Uomo Intense Eau de Parfum Spray by Valentino is a tribute to the vibrant energy of Rome and its nights. This composition unfolds a fascinating tension between aromatic freshness and a deep, sensual warmth. The flacon design, inspired by the iconic Valentino Rockstuds, emphasises the character of the fragrance through the combination of deep black and a bright pink accent. listings.rawTitle: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: A fragrance bouquet as colourful and versatile as its composer - but with a deep black name that skilfully underlines the seduction of the perfume: Crystal Noir by Versace is an unforgettably beautiful fragrance for exciting experiences in the evening or at night. On the one hand delicate and unobtrusive, on the other unmistakably feminine and intense - the Eau de Parfum Spray delights its wearers with these characteristics. Crystal Noir by Versace consists of various woody, fruity and floral accords . The fragrance bouquet opens with top notes of spicy ginger, intense cardamom and pepper. Fresh and light, this first scent envelops the wearer. This is followed by a warm, feminine note composed of fresh orange blossom and floral gardenia, without forgetting the peony. Finally, a woody aura awaits the wearer, resulting from the base note with sandalwood, ambergris and musk. If you can resist this perfume on your skin, it's your own fault...</h2 The Eau de Parfum Spray is also visually impressive to match its contents: cuboid in shape, with a striking cap and in the sensual colours of burgundy and black, it is waiting to be discovered by you. For yourself or as a gift!

listings.description: Versace Versense is an eau de toilette that presents a composition of freshness and sensuality. On the one hand, there are the fresh accords of pear juice and bitter orange and the floral accords of rose and iris . On the other hand, there are the warm and sensual nuances such as cedarwood, musk and amber, which represent the flirtatious and seductive side of Italy. The well-known fragrance brand behind the perfume has thought of everything here! The eau de parfum spray is also visually impressive with its characteristic bottle, which is a vibrant pink-violet colour on the one hand and stands for pure elegance with its golden cap on the other. If you already have similar fragrances from Versace, Dylan Purple will also fit in perfectly as a decorative element in the bathroom or on the dressing table.

Plus point: Like all Versace fragrances, Dylan Purple also comes in an eye-catching bottle that is a harmonious addition to your collection. Exciting fragrance journey through Italy's sunny side The floral-fruity fragrance character of Dylan Purple pour Femme captures the positive characteristics of Italy. On the one hand, there are the fresh accords of pear juice and bitter orange and the floral accords of rose and iris . On the other hand, there are the warm and sensual nuances such as cedarwood, musk and amber, which represent the flirtatious and seductive side of Italy. The well-known fragrance brand behind the perfume has thought of everything here! The eau de parfum spray is also visually impressive with its characteristic bottle, which is a vibrant pink-violet colour on the one hand and stands for pure elegance with its golden cap on the other. If you already have similar fragrances from Versace, Dylan Purple will also fit in perfectly as a decorative element in the bathroom or on the dressing table.

listings.rawTitle: DKNY 24/7 Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Discover DKNY 24/7 Eau de Parfum Spray, a fragrance that captures the never-sleeping energy of the city of New York. This perfume by Donna Karan New York is the perfect choice for the self-confident, dynamic woman who wants to savour every moment of her life to the full. The perfume opens with a surprising and invigorating top note of spicy pepper, fruity quince and refreshing rhubarb. This unique combination awakens the senses and immediately conveys a feeling of energy and vitality. A lush bouquet of flowers unfolds at the heart of DKNY's Eau de Parfum Spray. Jasmine, rose and intense tuberose combine to create a seductive floral composition that radiates elegance and femininity. This floral heart note forms the perfect transition between the fresh opening and the warm base. The base note of 24/7 rounds off the fragrance harmoniously and ensures its longevity. The woody, ambery scent of ambroxan gives the fragrance depth and character, while sensual musk provides a warm, cosy note. This combination creates an unforgettable fragrance signature that lasts all day. DKNY 24/7 Eau de Parfum Spray is a versatile fragrance that accompanies you from morning to night. It is just as suitable for a busy day at the office as it is for going out in the evening. The modern and elegant bottle design reflects the urban character of the fragrance and makes it a real eye-catcher on any dressing table.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Wood Pour Femme Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Dsquared2 Wood Pour Femme Eau de Toilette Spray is a modern fragrance composition that combines floral lightness with an unmistakable woody depth. The opening opens with a sparkling combination of mandarin and the subtle sweetness of raspberry leaves, gently enveloped by the delicate floral accords of magnolia and lily of the valley. At the heart of the fragrance, a fascinating bouquet of intense osmanthus and elegant jasmine unfolds, which is given a special tension by a subtle spiciness. The base note rounds off the olfactory experience and leaves a lasting, warm impression. This is where light-coloured woods meet the striking note of cedarwood and sensual ambroxan, which gives the fragrance its self-confident radiance. As an eau de toilette, Wood Pour Femme is an ideal companion for the day, revealing its full splendour especially in spring and summer. Fragrance direction: woody-floral A composition of fruity, floral and warm woody notes Top notes characterised by mandarin, raspberry leaves and magnolia Ideal for everyday use, especially in spring and summer

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 ICON Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Dsquared2 ICON Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray has truly earned its name: the fragrance pyramid of this perfume is at least as iconic as the bottle. It shows in an impressive way how such a simple contrast between black and white can still attract attention almost magically. However, the big highlight of this perfume awaits you with the first spritz: it is immediately apparent why the bottle has such a high-contrast design - because the composition of this perfume is also characterised by many contrasts and natural counterparts. A masculine yet light fragrance On the nose, Dsquared2 ICON Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray opens with sparkling citrus fruits, which are given both a warm and spicy note by the addition of ginger. The play of contrasts in Dsquared2 ICON Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray continues in the heart, where spicy icons such as clary sage meet the floral and often rather soft accords of geranium, black tulip and lavender. In the base note, woody accords set the tone together with patchouli - the result is a masculine, modern, contrasting and, above all, bold fragrance that is highly addictive.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Wood Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The men's fragrance Wood Pour Homme by Dsquared² was launched in 2018 together with the Eau de Toilette Spray Wood Pour Femme. As the name suggests, the fragrance is fresh and woody . The Wood Pour Homme bottle has a classic shape and is coloured a transparent brown. The closure of the bottle is reminiscent of a wooden cork, further emphasising the character of the fragrance. Equipped with above-average longevity and sillage, the eau de toilette spray delights with its masculine and modern presence that suits all occasions. More wood from Dsquared² for him Alberto Morillas creates a top note of mandarin, Sicilian lemon and Calabrian bergamot for the Wood Pour Homme fragrance. In the heart note, cardamom and ginger meet green-tart violet leaves. Finally, vetiver and ambrox combine with light-coloured woods to create a fine base note. The eau de toilette spray is a worthy successor to the numerous fragrances from Dsquared² that are dedicated to the theme of wood. The almost purist structure makes the fragrance interesting not only for lovers of woody scents. Dsquared² would like to divide the spirits, but with Wood Pour Homme this will be difficult, because it is the perfect summer fragrance for men.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Original Wood Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Original Wood Eau de Parfum Spray by Dsquared2 is a powerful fragrance composition inspired by the strength and complexity of wood. The fragrance opens with an invigorating freshness of violet leaf and aquatic notes, complemented by the spicy warmth of cardamom from Guatemala. A striking woody accord of vetiver, cedarwood and silver fir unfolds in the heart, reminiscent of the clear atmosphere of a forest after a rain shower. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a warm and creamy base of musk, Indonesian patchouli and herbal amber, which lends the fragrance a long-lasting depth. Presented in a straightforward bottle with brand-typical elements, Original Wood is a versatile companion for everyday life and special moments. Fragrance character: Woody, fresh and spicy Top note: A composition of violet leaf, aquatic notes and cardamom. Heart note: A striking woody accord of vetiver, cedarwood and silver fir. Base note: Warm notes of musk, patchouli and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Green Wood Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Green Wood Eau de Toilette Spray by Dsquared2 is a composition based on the interplay of fresh, spicy and woody notes. It opens with an energetic combination of tangy lemon and spicy bourbon pepper, accompanied by the aromatic plant santolina. In the heart note, the intense character of the fragrance unfolds through earthy vetiver, striking cedarwood and warm resins. This woody depth is rounded off in the base by a blend of ambroxan, cypriol and musk, which ensures a long-lasting and expressive finish. The fragrance is presented in an elegant, green glass bottle with a wooden cap that emphasises the natural aesthetic of the creation. Green Wood is a modern yet timeless everyday companion that leaves a confident signature. listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 ICON Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The ICON Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray by Dsquared2 is a multi-layered, floral-fruity composition that exudes elegance and modernity. The fragrance opens with a sparkling top note of Italian mandarin, lemon and pear, which is given a lively freshness by blackcurrant and a hint of pink pepper. At the heart of the creation, a feminine bouquet of jasmine unfolds, which is given an appealing sweetness by a fine praline note without dominating. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm and sensual base note. This is where sandalwood, soft musk and sweet vanilla meet the special woody notes of Akigalawood and ash wood, which lend the perfume a long-lasting depth. The result is a multi-faceted fragrance that emphasises a self-confident yet graceful aura. Fragrance direction: Floral-fruity Top notes: Italian mandarin, lemon, pear, pink pepper Heart note: jasmine, praline Base notes: sandalwood, musk, vanilla, acigalawood

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Red Wood Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Red Wood Eau de Toilette Spray by Dsquared2 was created in 2019 and is a fruity and woody fragrance for women. It is not just the bright red colour of the bottle that makes the fragrance stand out. After all, the eau de toilette spray has top notes of cranberry and pink pepper. The heart note mixes roses and magnolias with lychees, while the base consists of musk, amberwood and cedarwood. Red Wood by Dsquared2 has above-average longevity and sillage, which is particularly suited to all women who like sweet fragrances. Wood can be so sexy With a name like Red Wood, you would naturally expect an eau de toilette spray with woody aromas. But the fragrance from Dsquared2 goes beyond that. Because the wood is the centrepiece of the fragrance. At the same time, however, the perfumers have succeeded in creating a fantastically feminine eau de toilette spray. The women's fragrance is sweet in a grown-up way. It is sexy , it is confident and suits many different occasions, both during the day and in the evening. Dsquared2 scores particularly well with this fragrance in the cool and cold season. If you like woods, you have to try Red Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 2 Wood Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: A fascinating unisex fragrance from the lifestyle label Dsquared2 from Canada: 2 Wood is a lively and vitalising fragrance for men and women. This is ensured by fresh notes of lemon, lemon and pepper in the top note. They combine with woody, energising aromas of fir, cedar and vetiver in the heart note. Playing with contrasts is what makes this unisex fragrance so special. The fragrance character of 2 Wood is clear, crisp, fresh and spicy. listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY GENTLEMAN GIVENCHY Eau de Parfum Spray Réserve Privée 60 ml
listings.description: The Gentleman Givenchy Réserve Privée Eau de Parfum Spray unfolds a fascinating duality, inspired by the world of exquisite spirits and high perfume art. This woody-floral amber composition is characterised by an unusual ingredient: an absolute of whisky extracted in Grasse from the barley of a Scottish distillery. In the top note, this warm, characteristic aroma meets the freshness of Italian bergamot. This is followed by a heart note that combines the powdery elegance of iris with the sweetness of chestnut and balsamic benzoin resin. The base of Virginia cedarwood, Haitian vetiver and Indonesian patchouli lends the fragrance a long-lasting, earthy depth. The result is a harmonious and intense composition that impresses with its sophistication and expressive character. Fragrance family: woody-floral-amber Speciality: Contains an exclusive absolute of whisky Character: Intense and harmonious Fragrance notes: Iris, chestnut and cedar wood

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY IRRÉSISTIBLE Eau de Parfum Spray 35 ml
listings.description: The GIVENCHY IRRÉSISTIBLE Eau de Parfum Spray is a floral-fruity fragrance composition with warm, woody accents. The Damask rose from Turkey takes centre stage, unfolding its full splendour in the heart note and accompanied by powdery iris butter. The fragrance opens with a fresh combination of juicy pear and ambrette, which gives the fragrance a light, inviting nuance. The base of cedarwood and blond wood provides a soft and long-lasting finish that emphasises the elegant structure of the perfume. Developed by the renowned perfumers Fanny Bal, Anne Flipo and Dominique Ropion, this fragrance is a modern yet timeless creation. It is suitable for every occasion and every season without being overpowering. The bottle is also available in an environmentally friendly, refillable version. listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Parfum Spray Scandal Elixir 30 ml
listings.description: The Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Elixir Parfum Spray presents itself as an intense reinterpretation of the well-known Scandal line and focuses on a fragrance composition rich in contrasts. At the centre of this olfactory experience is a striking top note of black cherry, which lends a fruity depth to the opening. This first impression is accompanied by a powerful heart of patchouli, which can provide an earthy yet elegant structure. The base note rounds off the fragrance profile with the warmth of tonka bean, creating a long-lasting and multi-faceted presence on the skin. Visually, the bottle reflects the intensity of the contents: the glass has a colour gradient from brown to transparent and features vertical indentations that give the design a special feel. A golden label with the characteristic lettering and a matching cap complete the aesthetic overall look of this perfume concentration, which is manufactured in Spain. Fragrance: Intense and contrasting with fruity and warm accents Head note: Black cherry. Heart note: Patchouli. Base note: Tonka bean. Flacon: Multifaceted glass design with colour gradient and golden details.

listings.description: Immerse yourself in the sensual world of Jil Sander with the Sunset Eau de Parfum Spray Intense. Magical fragrance for women by Jil Sander But the real centrepiece of Sunset Eau de Parfum Spray Intense is revealed in the base note. Whether you are preparing for a special occasion or simply want to enhance your everyday life, this sunset fragrance is a must-have. The Eau de Parfum Spray Intense represents the modern woman who is both delicate and strong, who has the ability to transform every moment of her life into something special. The flacon reflects the elegance and class of Jil Sander. With a minimalist design, but with a striking colour scheme and golden lettering, similar to the colours of a breathtaking sunset, it radiates a modern aesthetic.

listings.description: The Yes I Am Eau de Parfum Spray by Cacharel is a multi-faceted composition that expresses self-confidence and modern femininity. listings.rawTitle: Cacharel Eden Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Cacharel Eden Eau de Parfum Spray is a timeless composition that has been inspiring since its creation in 1994 by perfumer Jean Guichard. The fragrance belongs to the family of floral-fruity perfumes and unfolds a multi-layered presence. It opens with a refreshing and sparkling top note of mandarin, bergamot and lemon, which is complemented by fruity nuances of peach. The heart of the composition reveals an opulent floral bouquet in which delicate water lily, lotus, lily of the valley and jasmine combine to create a feminine accord. The base note ensures a long-lasting and harmonious finish. This is where warm and sensual components such as sandalwood, patchouli, tonka bean and cedarwood come together and give the fragrance its depth. Eden presents itself as a lively and elegant fragrance that is suitable for a variety of occasions and is available in a stylish spray bottle. The eau de parfum belongs to the fougère-amber-fruity fragrance family and opens with a fresh top note of blackcurrant, Italian green mandarin and Calabrian bergamot. In the heart, an interplay of lavender, bourbon geranium and Australian sandalwood unfolds, leading into a warm, woody-balsamic base. Notes of bourbon vanilla from Madagascar, fir balsam and oak moss lend the fragrance an expressive depth and a balanced character. The composition is characterised by a remarkable presence and a long-lasting finish. The fragrance is presented in a minimalist bottle with a translucent silver finish, whose black diamond logo is inspired by New York architecture and emphasises the urban, sophisticated style of the perfume. An urban men's fragrance from the fougère-amber-fruity fragrance family. Composition of fruity top notes, a heart of lavender and sandalwood and a woody-balsamic base. Characterised by a long-lasting presence. Presented in a minimalist bottle inspired by New York architecture.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Ralph's Club Eau de Parfum Spray by Ralph Lauren is a composition that exudes self-confidence and understated elegance. This men's fragrance, created by perfumer Dominique Ropion, opens with an aromatic freshness of lavandin and clary sage, which is subtly complemented by a fine note of cardamom. At the heart of the creation, the striking warmth of Virginia cedarwood unfolds, harmoniously interacting with rose geranium absolute and echoing the lavender and sage notes. The base anchors the fragrance experience for a long time with the earthy tones of vetiver and patchouli and the soft depth of cashmeran. This woody-spicy fragrance signature is present, but not dominant, and is therefore suitable for everyday wear as well as for special moments in the evening. The matt black bottle with copper-coloured accents and the iconic monogram on the hinged lid reflects the sophisticated character of the fragrance. A woody, spicy men's fragrance with an elegant appeal. Composition with notes of lavender, Virginia cedarwood and vetiver. Versatile for everyday wear and special occasions. Eau de Parfum with a long-lasting presence.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo Blue Eau de Parfum Spray 75 ml
listings.description: The Polo Blue Eau de Parfum Spray by Ralph Lauren is a composition inspired by the vastness of the ocean and the energy of a clear sky. Created by perfumer Carlos Benaïm, the fragrance opens with an invigorating wave of maritime notes combined with the juicy freshness of melon, cucumber and tangy mandarin. An aromatic bouquet unfolds in the heart, in which spicy basil meets the earthy tones of sage and clary sage. The base note lends the fragrance an elegant depth with a blend of soft suede, vetiver, woody notes and musk. The result is a multi-layered, aquatic fragrance character that is just as suitable for everyday wear as it is for various occasions. The characteristic cobalt blue bottle emphasises the powerful and free charisma of the fragrance creation. listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo Blue Eau de Toilette Spray 40 ml
listings.description: The Ralph Lauren Polo Blue Eau de Toilette Spray captures the freedom of the open sky and the energy of the open ocean in one fragrance. Since its launch in 2003, this aromatic-fougère men's fragrance has been characterised by a fresh and aquatic composition. It opens with an invigorating blend of juicy melon, crisp cucumber and tangy mandarin. An aromatic bouquet of basil and sage unfolds in the heart, harmoniously rounded off by geranium. The base lends the fragrance a masculine depth and a lasting impression with warm wood tones, musk and a hint of suede. The simple, royal blue bottle with the iconic logo reflects the clear and elegant character of the fragrance and makes it a timeless classic for everyday use, especially on warmer days. Fragrance direction: Aromatic fougère Character: Fresh, aquatic, woody Head notes: Melon, cucumber, mandarin Heart notes: Basil, sage, geranium Base notes: Musk, woody notes, suede

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo Blue Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: The Polo Blue fragrance by Ralph Lauren is a powerful yet elegant interpretation of the iconic fragrance collection. Since its launch in 2022, this men's fragrance has inspired with its high concentration and multi-layered, aromatic-woody character. The olfactory journey begins with an invigorating top note, in which the sparkling freshness of grapefruit and bergamot sets the tone. In the heart of the composition, an aromatic bouquet of lavender and artemisia unfolds, which is given a striking depth by fine spices. The fragrance concludes with a warm and persistent base note, in which precious sandalwood and earthy vetiver meet the sensual nuances of amber and musk. This harmonious interplay preserves the classic freshness of the line, but adds an intense, woody warmth. The fragrance develops a present and striking aura that is suitable for special occasions throughout the year. Fragrance direction: Aromatic-woody Fragrance character: Intense, warm, fresh Top notes: grapefruit, bergamot Base note: sandalwood, vetiver, amber

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Vanilla Eau de Toilette Spray 25 ml
listings.description: The Vanilla Eau de Toilette Spray by Alyssa Ashley is a harmonious composition that combines fresh accents with warm nuances. Since 1990, this fragrance has stood for an unmistakable combination of effervescence and gentle sweetness. The top note opens the olfactory experience with invigorating accords of bergamot and lemon, which provide a clear and bright prelude. A floral bouquet then unfolds at the heart of the creation, in which jasmine plays a central role and creates an elegant transition. The arrangement is supported by a dominant base note of vanilla, which gives the eau de toilette its characteristic, creamy and soft character. Subtle hints of caramel or musk can also be detected, emphasising the depth of the fragrance. The brand has also opted for a classic design: a rectangular glass bottle provides a clear view of the yellow-coloured liquid inside. A beige-coloured, shiny cap and the striking yellow label with the curved red lettering "Vanilla" complete the look. The balanced blend of ingredients makes the spray suitable for daily use and is gentle on the skin. listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Vanilla Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Since 1968, the Alyssa Ashley label has been known for capturing the classic fragrances of the flower power generation in original recipes and new fragrance formulas in flacons. Musk, patchouli and vanilla, among others, inspire the "créateurs de parfum" behind the label to constantly create new fragrances. Sensual, sweet, elegant: perfumes with a strong vanilla note are a timeless, enduring trend for women and increasingly for men. For more than 100 years, these sweet fragrances have found a place on the shelves of the most exclusive perfumeries. With the unisex fragrance Vanilla , Alyssa Ashley enriched the long line of successful vanilla fragrance creations in 1990 with her own new interpretation on the theme of vanilla. Vanilla by Alyssa Ashley - an uncompromising fragrance The top note opens with the invigorating tropical fruits bergamot and lemon. This tart, tangy opening ensures that the eau de parfum spray does not lose itself in an excess of sweetness later on. The floral heart note is characterised by the intense yet delicate aroma of jasmine blossom. Deep and powdery, the base note is grounding with vanilla essences. The result is an irresistible eau de parfum spray for lovers of sweet fragrances. If you want to wrap yourself in vanilla from head to toe, you will find numerous care products from the same fragrance line here.

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Essence De Patchouli Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Essence De Patchouli by Alyssa Ashley gets to the point The Essence De Patchouli eau de parfum spray draws attention to itself with an unusual combination . The perfume captivates with its simple top and heart notes, which consist solely of geranium, roses and iris roots. It becomes opulent and interesting in the base, which, in keeping with the name, naturally consists primarily of patchouli. The eau de parfum spray also features vanilla and musk, coumarin and French labdanum as well as guaiac wood and Virginia cedar. The result is a long-lasting, very sensual and warm perfume that is simply perfect for all women who embrace and know how to deal with their sensual femininity. With Essence De Patchouli, Alyssa Ashley celebrates femininity, the beauty that women stand for and the strength that is inherent in every woman. The aromatic, sensual fragrance has been around since 2009 and you should definitely give it a try if you like warm fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Ambre Gris Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Since its launch in 2002, Ambre Gris Eau de Parfum Spray by Alyssa Ashley has been synonymous with a multi-faceted and profound fragrance signature. The composition combines fresh, citrusy elements with warm, ambery accords to create a harmonious overall picture. The olfactory experience opens with a sparkling top note in which Calabrian bergamot and Sicilian lemon meet, lending a certain lightness to the opening. This is followed by a floral heart, which is characterised by the fine aromas of Bulgarian rose, Indian jasmine and orange blossom. The complex base note, which combines precious ambergris, sandalwood and Madagascar vanilla with Virginia cedarwood and musk, ensures a long-lasting and sensual finish. This blend lends the fragrance a timeless elegance that can unfold regardless of the season. The design of the bottle also reflects the classic claim: a rectangular clear glass container reveals the light-coloured liquid and is crowned by a black label with gold lettering and a shiny, gold cap. The intertwined symbol embossed on the front rounds off the visual appearance and emphasises the brand's identity. listings.rawTitle: Armani di Gioia Eau de Parfum Spray Acqua di Gioia 30 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the power of nature, Acqua di Gioia by Giorgio Armani is a floral-aquatic fragrance that embodies lightness and freshness. The composition opens with the sparkling note of lime primofiore. The transparent elegance of Sambac jasmine unfolds in the heart, complemented by subtle accents of sweet peony that lend a gentle sensuality. The base of warm cedar wood provides a subtle depth and harmoniously rounds off the fragrance experience. The design of the bottle picks up on the theme of nature: its curved shape is reminiscent of a drop of water, while the mint green colour and emerald-like cap emphasise the aquatic element. Acqua di Gioia is a tribute to optimism and a connection with nature. Floral-aquatic fragrance by Giorgio Armani Composition of lime, Sambac jasmine and cedar wood Embodies freshness, lightness and naturalness Flacon in the design of a drop of water

listings.rawTitle: Armani Code Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Armani Code Femme Eau de Parfum Spray by Giorgio Armani is a composition full of warmth and sensuality. It opens with an invigorating combination of jasmine, sweet orange and a subtle accent of bitter orange. The full splendour of orange blossom unfolds at the heart of the creation, which, together with more jasmine and a surprising note of ginger, creates a fascinating depth. The fragrance experience is rounded off and anchored by a base of soft honey, creamy vanilla and fine sandalwood. As a fragrance from the floral family, this eau de parfum unfolds its character particularly well on cooler days in autumn and winter as well as on special occasions in the evening. listings.rawTitle: Armani Emporio Armani You Eau de Parfum Spray Stronger With You Powerfully 50 ml
listings.description: The Emporio Armani You Eau de Parfum Spray Stronger With You Powerfully expands the Italian fashion house's popular fragrance collection with an intense and characterful composition. This men's fragrance presents itself as a powerful interpretation of the classic fougère structure, enriched with warm amber accents. The opening surprises with a dynamic interplay of fresh mandarin and bergamot, which meet the spicy sharpness of black pepper. An aromatic depth unfolds in the heart, characterised by diva lavender and a striking accord of spices such as saffron, cinnamon and clove. These spicy facets are subtly rounded off by fruity nuances of apricot or cherry. The base note provides a long-lasting and warm finish, combining sweet vanilla and bourbon vanilla with the characteristic aroma of candied and roasted chestnut. Amberwood and leather lend the base an additional masculine structure. The rectangular glass bottle with its rounded corners and metallic cap visually emphasises the robustness of the fragrance. Fragrance family: Ambery fougère with spicy and warm accents. Top notes: Fresh citrus notes of mandarin and bergamot combined with black pepper. Heart note: Aromatic lavender meets spices such as saffron and cinnamon. Base note: Warm vanilla accords combined with roasted chestnut and amberwood. Design: Striking glass bottle with metallic cap and dark-coloured liquid.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Code Homme Eau de Parfum Spray - refillable 50 ml
listings.description: The Armani Code Homme Eau de Parfum is a modern interpretation of an ambery and spicy fougère fragrance that captivates with its contrasting notes. The composition opens with the sparkling and invigorating freshness of green mandarin, which provides a dynamic prelude. An aromatic-woody melange unfolds in the heart note, in which the characteristic spiciness of nutmeg essence meets the gentle tones of lavender. This combination creates a fascinating depth that is completed in the base note. A rich tonka bean absolute dominates here, giving the fragrance its characteristic, warm and sensual signature. Cedarwood and amber round off the creation and create an elegant, long-lasting impression. The iconic black bottle with golden accents is not only a visual statement, but has also been deliberately designed to be refillable to allow for sustainable use. Amber-like, spicy fougère fragrance composition . A combination of green mandarin, nutmeg and tonka bean. Combines dynamic freshness with sensual warmth. Iconic bottle with practical refill function.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Emporio Armani Eau de Parfum Spray Emporio She 50 ml
listings.description: The Emporio Armani She Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition that captivates with its soft and feminine aura. It opens with a fruity combination of mandarin and pear, which blends harmoniously into a floral heart note of delicate jasmine and heliotrope. At the centre of the fragrance is a soft vanilla essence, which is accompanied by an accord of angelica and creates a subtle, warm presence. The fragrance character is deliberately unobtrusive and remains pleasantly close to the skin, making it a suitable companion for everyday wear, especially during the cooler seasons such as autumn and winter. To optimise the bouquet, we recommend spraying the fragrance onto warm areas of skin, such as the inside of the wrists, from a distance of around 20 cm. Bottled in a simple yet sophisticated bottle, the design emphasises the subtle elegance of the fragrance creation. Fragrance character: Gentle, feminine and warm Fragrance notes: A composition of vanilla, jasmine, mandarin and pear Occasion: An ideal companion for everyday wear and the cooler seasons Presentation: Bottled in a timelessly elegant bottle

listings.rawTitle: Armani My Way Eau de Parfum Spray Intense - Refillable 30 ml

It opens with a radiant note of Egyptian orange blossom, which paves the way for an opulent heart of Indian tuberose and jasmine. This floral richness leads into a warm and sensual base in which creamy sandalwood from New Caledonia meets precious vanilla from Madagascar. The fragrance created by perfumer Carlos Benaïm emphasises the facets of modern femininity and authenticity. The design of the bottle is elegant and also refillable, allowing you to enjoy the fragrance for longer. An intense floral-sweet fragrance with a warm, woody base. listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The composition of Lacoste Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray is characterised by a sophisticated balance of floral, woody and musky elements that embody a modern yet timeless aesthetic. The olfactory experience opens with a top note full of character, combining the fruity freshness of green apple and bergamot with the subtle spiciness of black pepper, purple freesia and nutmeg oil. As the fragrance progresses, a multi-layered heart unfolds, combining classic floral accords of white jasmine, rose and violet with the delicate nuances of hibiscus and heliotrope to create a harmonious bouquet. The complex base note, which combines the woody depth of sandalwood and cedarwood with incense, labdanum and a velvety suede accord and musk, ensures a long-lasting and warm finish. The design of the bottle picks up on this clear line visually: A slender, rectangular glass body with rounded corners and pale yellow contents is topped by a cylindrical cap with a textured, gold-coloured surface. On the front, the characteristic gold-coloured crocodile logo is emblazoned on a vertical label, discreetly underlining the affiliation with the brand. Created by Olivier Cresp, this fragrance stands for an understated elegance that radiates creativity and a sense of style. Fragrance family: Floral-woody with musky nuances Top notes: Combination of freesia, black pepper and green apple Base: Warm accords of sandalwood, incense and suede Design: Elegant glass bottle with gold-coloured accents and crocodile logo

listings.rawTitle: KENZO Kenzo Jungle Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: KENZO JUNGLE Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition by master perfumer Dominique Ropion that is characterised by an unmistakable, spicy-amber character. The fragrance opens with a lively top note of cardamom, clove and a hint of mandarin. An opulent bouquet unfolds in the heart, in which the exotic sweetness of mango meets floral notes of ylang-ylang, gardenia and heliotrope, rounded off by a fascinating nuance of liquorice and vanilla flower. This eau de parfum has a remarkable presence and longevity, making it an ideal companion for the cooler months. The bottle is adorned with a golden elephant, which symbolises a good omen and makes the design unique. listings.rawTitle: KENZO Kenzo Amour Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: KENZO AMOUR Eau de Parfum is an olfactory interpretation of a journey full of love and gentle impressions. Created by Daphné Bugey in 2006, the fragrance unfolds with delicate notes of cherry and frangipani blossom. These floral accents are then combined with the subtle aroma of white tea and rice steam, resulting in a soft and powdery composition. A warm base of vanilla, musk, incense and the characteristic Thanaka wood rounds off the fragrance experience and lends it a long-lasting depth. This woody-floral musk fragrance is particularly suitable for the cooler days of autumn and winter. The design of the fragrance was honoured with the prestigious FiFi Award for best packaging and as fragrance of the year in its category. Fragrance: Floral, woody, musky Character: Soft, powdery and sensual Fragrance notes: Cherry blossom, white tea, rice, vanilla, musk Product type: Eau de Parfum Spray

listings.rawTitle: KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO Eau de Parfum Spray Le Rouge 30 ml
listings.description: LE ROUGE FLOWER Eau de Parfum by KENZO reinterprets the iconic FLOWER signature in a powerful and sensual way. This floral-gourmand fragrance for women stands for intensity, depth and emotional radiance and is aimed at women who embody strength and elegance in equal measure. The opening is clear and pure: delicate musk meets fine rice vapour and gives the fragrance a modern, almost floating lightness. At the heart, the Damask rose unfolds in a more intense, multi-faceted form that redefines floral sensuality. The base seduces with a warm, enveloping composition of vanilla and sandalwood, enhanced by Amberever®, a powerful woody molecule that gives the fragrance depth and a long-lasting presence. As an olfactory interpretation of the colour red, LE ROUGE FLOWER combines vibrant energy with the Japanese DNA of the Maison KENZO and at the same time stands for a conscious commitment to sustainability. listings.rawTitle: KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO Eau de Parfum Spray Ikebana Sakura 40 ml
listings.description: The KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO Ikebana Eau de Parfum Spray is an olfactory homage to Kenzo Takada's love of flowers and the art of living. Inspired by the Japanese art of flower arranging, Ikebana, a floral-woody composition created by perfumers Alexandra Monet and Alberto Morillas unfolds. At the centre of the fragrance is a balance of three distinctive notes: It opens with the unique aroma of sobacha tea, followed by the delicate sakura cherry blossom, enhanced by Indian tuberose absolute. A warm base of Australian sandalwood, cedarwood and vetiver gives the fragrance a lasting depth. Made in France, the eau de parfum consists of around 90% ingredients of natural origin. The bottle, which is reminiscent of a Japanese kakemono, emphasises the brand's conscious approach through the use of recycled materials and a recyclable cap. A floral-woody fragrance inspired by the Japanese art of ikebana. Main notes of sobacha tea, sakura cherry blossom and Australian sandalwood. Consists of around 90% ingredients of natural origin. listings.rawTitle: KENZO Kenzo Homme Eau de Parfum Spray Indigo 60 ml
listings.description: The KENZO HOMME Indigo Eau de Parfum Spray is a men's fragrance composition inspired by the power of nature. The base note anchors the composition with a warm leather accord, which is characterised by smoky nuances and the depth of Akigala wood, sandalwood and vetiver. The design of the bottle picks up on this closeness to nature: The opaque, indigo blue lacquer with a matt texture is reminiscent of a bamboo cane, while the bevelled cap is inspired by the shape of a katana samurai sword. listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Eau de Toilette Spray Mirto di Panarea 50 ml
listings.description: Panarea: The smallest and oldest Aeolian island radiates peace and tranquillity. Fragmented bays, bordered by luminous olive groves, are lapped by emerald-green waters. The myrtle plant grows among wild pistachios, agaves and broom. Even the goddess Venus wanted to adorn herself with a myrtle wreath when she was chosen by Paride. Myrtle has always symbolised beauty and love, and in the Middle Ages its fragrance was known as "angel's water". The fragrance of Mirto di Panarea caresses the skin and soul with a pleasant, intensely regenerating breeze from the Italian Mediterranean. The unmistakable scent of myrtle spreads slowly and pleasantly. The fragrance opens with an elegant, sparkling top note, characterised by citrus accents such as Calabrian lemon and sweet orange. It is emphasised by the simple and unadulterated aroma of basil. The heart note unfolds a blossoming core of velvet and elegance, where accents of jasmine, rose and lilac meet a light sea breeze and traces of blackcurrant. A feeling of deep well-being that reaches its full perfection in the woody base note with the aromatic scents of wild pistachio and juniper as well as cedarwood and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Oud & Spice 50 ml
listings.description: The Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum Spray from the Signatures Of The Sun fragrance line by Acqua di Parma combines exquisite spices with warm woody and appealing oriental fragrance accords. With spirited pepper and elegant agarwood The Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum Spray is a self-confident fragrance for men, based on a slightly tart base, which is livened up by sparkling fruity nuances in the top note. An exquisite blend of spices rounds off the fragrance, which has been available since 2021, and gives it temperament. Upon application, Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum Spray initially envelops you in an invigorating blend of tangy bergamot and seductive raspberries, which combine with an elegant rose nuance. The heart note consists of pink pepper , cloves and cinnamon and gives the creation strength and an excitingly passionate tone. The base has a gentle and calming effect: warm agarwood meets creamy ladan resin and oriental patchouli, which has a pleasantly rough and masculine effect.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Sandalo 50 ml
listings.description: Sandalo is a fresh and woody eau de parfum spray from the exclusive Milanese boutique Acqua di Parma. Launched in 2016, the unisex fragrance is characterised by a harmonious composition full of elegance and freshness . Very precious and rare sandalwood from India, which is characterised by the particular richness and intensity of its aromas, is the olfactory theme of this perfume. The citrus notes typical of the Colonia creation create a fascinating arc of tension. Timeless elegance in a trendy style Acqua di Parma Sandalo opens sparklingly fresh with a wide range of citrusy notes. The multi-faceted fragrance of petit grain, the oil from the leaves of the bitter orange, is joined by sparkling notes of subtly tart bergamot, ripe lemon and juicy orange. In the heart note, Acqua di Parma Sandalo Eau de Parfum Spray presents an irresistible play of colours and aromas. The intense, unmistakable scent of lavender from Provence is given additional character and depth by spicy, creamy accents of cardamom. In the base of the fragrance, the precious sandalwood impressively brings its elegance to the fore. Delicious, opulent tonka bean and soft ambergris bring this enchanting eau de parfum spray to an impressive close with a hint of irresistible sensuality. A unisex perfume that fascinates with its sophisticated composition and the intensity of its notes.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Oud 50 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Oud is a new fragrance from Acqua di Parma. Launched in 2019, the Eau de Parfum Spray is a variation of Colonia Oud, which has been available since 2012 and is an Eau de Cologne Concentrée. Of course, both woody-spicy fragrances are men's fragrances, but some women also like to wear them. The eau de parfum spray from Acqua di Parma is naturally significantly stronger in its presence and has enormous longevity and sillage, just as you would expect from an eau de parfum spray from the traditional Milanese brand. A fragrance that definitely stands out The top note of Acqua di Parma perfume begins with Italian orange and Calabrian bergamot. It gives way to heart notes of Russian coriander, Haitian amyris and, of course, precious oud. In the almost opulent base, the flavours of Atlas cedar meet Indonesian patchouli, fine sandalwood and musk. The result is a noble masculine composition that is particularly suitable for wearing on cooler days, but can also be worn on summer evenings. Acqua di Parma Oud is a fragrance that flatters the modern man of today. This is because the fragrance has a clear but not overpowering presence.

listings.description: The embodiment of feminine Italian elegance and a sensual new interpretation of the iris - that’s Iris Nobile. The structure of the top note distinguishes itself with the tingling and fresh notes: Bergamot from Calabria, the typical component of the Chypré scent chord, mandarin, star aniseed and an absolute from orange water. The extraordinarily feminine heart note becomes voluminous and sophisticated with the elegant Florentine iris, ylang-ylang, caraway and peach. The base note, which consists of oak tree musk, cupid crystals, Madagascar vanilla and patchouli adds fascination and warmth.

listings.description: The Colonia Quercia fragrance dates back to 2016 and was released as an eau de parfum spray by Acqua di Parma in 2019. The fragrance of the masculine eau de parfum spray is spicy and woody . It is debatable whether the perfume is more of a unisex fragrance or a men's fragrance. However, you won't argue about the elegant composition, the chic black bottle or the enormous longevity and sillage. Querica by Acqua di Parma is not an eau de parfum spray for everyone. The fragrance is aimed at people who are looking for the extraordinary , but don't want to find it in screamingly loud compositions. They are not looking for a fragrance with rough edges, but something expressive. Intensity sends its regards The top note of Acqua di Parma Quercia consists of pink pepper, petitgrain, lemon and bergamot. The heart note combines rose geranium, cardamom and cedarwood. Patchouli, tonka bean absolute and oakmoss absolute round off the eau de parfum. Acqua di Parma Quercia is suitable for everyday wear, but can also be worn in the evening. The eau de parfum spray has the all-round qualities typical of the Milanese label, which is aimed at the modern man of today, who feels just as comfortable in jeans as in a suit.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Osmanthus 50 ml
listings.description: Acqua di Parma Osmanthus is a floral-fruity unisex perfume from 2019. The eau de parfum spray is a wonderful addition to the 'Signature of the Sun' fragrance line, which presents particularly precious olfactory ingredients against a radiant, sun-drenched backdrop. Acqua di Parma Osmanthus invites you to take an unforgettable walk through the green forest landscape of south-east Asia . This is the home of the shrub from whose flowers the irresistibly fruity-scented absolute that gives the eau de parfum spray its name is extracted. Its delicate, delicious peach aromas carry subtle nuances of wood and leather and ensure elegant sensuality. An elegant floral fragrance with a sparkling opening Acqua di Parma Osmanthus opens sparkling and fresh with juicy, green mandarin from Sicily and fragrant neroli oil, which powerfully reveals its citrusy richness. The top note brings subtly sensual accents into play. The floral fragrance of delicate peony is joined by beguiling ambrette with its soft, creamy musky scent. A hint of pink pepper discreetly limits the intense notes and gives the eau de parfum spray a fascinating tingle. In the base of the perfume, the star of the show, the osmanthus fragrance, unfolds all its magic. Mossy, woody patchouli supports its sensual elegance with mossy, woody accents.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Yuzu 50 ml
listings.description: The citrus-aromatic Eau de Parfum Spray Yuzu is the latest member of the 'Frutti d'Oro' family from the traditional luxury perfume house Acqua di Parma. Launched in 2019, the unisex fragrance by French star perfumers Nicolas Bonneville and François Demachy is dedicated to Japan's most delicious fruit , the yuzu. Its unique, bitter-sweet aroma combines with the citrusy accents so typical of Acqua di Parma fragrances to create a tingling, fresh fragrance experience with an addictive character. A sparkling fragrance with plenty of elegance and a touch of sensuality The Eau de Parfum Spray opens with a revitalising cocktail in which an intense yuzu accent is joined by the aromas of juicy bergamot from Calabria and sparkling Szechuan pepper. Delicate, graceful blossoms unfold their magic in the heart of the perfume. It presents an elegant, white bouquet of noble lotus, delicate mimosa and fragrant jasmine, gently framed by a green nuance of violet leaf. The extraordinary base of the Eau de Parfum Spray from Acqua di Parma is decidedly sensual. Soft, warm musk, precious sandalwood and liquorice and a hint of liquorice bring the fragrance to an impressive close.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Magnolia Infinita 100 ml
listings.description: Italian sophistication and discreet luxury: this is what Acqua di Parma has stood for since it was founded in 1916. Created by Baron Carlo Magnani from Parma for personal fragrances, Acqua di Parma has maintained its reputation as a centre of elegant fragrances to this day. The Signatures Of The Sun series with the composition Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum Spray is a testament to the craftsmanship of Italian perfumery. The creation for women combines the radiant scent of magnolia with the vibrancy of fresh citrus notes. Released in 2022, Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum Spray is still a relatively new addition to the Acqua di Parma fragrances. Elegant and floral fragrance cocktail in an iconic bottle The Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum Spray from the Signatures Of The Sun series combines the scent of Calabrian bergamot and the fresh aroma of orange and lemon in the top note. A few moments later, the intense and lush heart note surprises with a combination of magnolia, jasmine, rose and ylang-ylang. The sensual notes of musk and patchouli meet in the base. The transparent black bottle of Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum Spray is iconic. It is adorned with the black Signatures of the Sun label. With its golden lettering, it interprets the vibrant rays of the sun.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Luce di Rosa Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: If you are looking for an exclusive and exquisite perfume, we recommend the eau de parfum spray Luce di Rosa from the Acqua di Parma label. This fragrance is characterised by both modernity and dynamism and pampers the olfactory senses in a unique way thanks to its composition of floral, woody and rosy notes. A perfume that knows how to refresh Luce di Rosa owes its incomparably fresh fragrance to a sophisticated fragrance pyramid. The top notes are bergamot, longoza oil and pink pepper , while the heart notes are rose oil, geranium and fresh black pepper . Finally, the base note is composed of vetiver oil, guaiac wood and cedar wood . It is therefore not surprising that this eau-de-perfume spray casts a very special spell over its wearer and their surroundings. Acqua di Parma is a unisex fragrance, making it suitable for couples who want to show that they belong together. It is no coincidence that this perfume is so captivating, as the Acqua di Parma company has existed since 1916 and can therefore look back on a long tradition. This eau-de-parfum spray, which is typical of the Italian art of living, is the result of a wealth of experience.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Eau de Parfum Spray Colonia Il Profumo 50 ml
listings.description: Experience the quintessence of Italian perfumery with Acqua di Parma's Colonia Il Profumo Eau de Parfum Spray. This exclusive perfume is a timeless unisex fragrance that captures the Mediterranean lifestyle in its purest form. The sparkling top note opens with a fascinating interplay of sun-ripened bergamot, juicy blood orange and refreshing grapefruit, refined by the elegant spice of petitgrain. This citrus symphony blends harmoniously into a floral, aromatic heart, where delicate orange blossom combines with tart rosemary and exotic ylang-ylang to create a seductive composition. Sensual unisex fragrance by Acqua di Parma for special occasions The full strength of character of the fragrance unfolds in the base note through the combination of earthy patchouli and woody vetiver, which give the perfume its unmistakable depth and persistence. Colonia Il Profumo is an aromatic-citrusy eau de parfum spray that is perfect for people who are looking for something special. The classic flacon design with the characteristic yellow label emphasises the timeless elegance of this extraordinary creation. A fragrance that skilfully blurs the boundaries between masculine and feminine, creating an exclusive aura that delights from morning to night. The perfect choice for individualists who value Italian craftsmanship and authentic luxury products.</p

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Eau de Toilette Spray 40 ml
listings.description: Davidoff Cool Water Eau de Toilette Spray is an iconic fragrance that evokes the untamed power and freshness of the ocean. Since its launch in 1988, this fragrance has been regarded as a timeless classic. It opens with an intense, aromatic wave in which marine notes blend with fresh mint, coriander and lavender. As the fragrance develops, the composition transitions into a heart of sandalwood, jasmine and neroli, which lends the scent a clear yet subtle depth. The base note ensures a long-lasting and warm finish, with nuances of musk, ambergris and cedarwood blending harmoniously. Presented in the distinctive blue bottle, the atomiser allows for easy and precise application. The eau de toilette unfolds best when sprayed from a short distance onto warm areas of skin such as the wrists. A timeless fragrance classic with a fresh and aquatic character. A composition of marine top notes, a woody heart and a warm musk-amber base. Ideal as an invigorating fragrance for everyday wear. Eau de Toilette in the iconic blue spray bottle.
