listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Night Dive Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Cool Water Night Dive: Fresh in a new way Davidoff stands for quality and innovative men’s fragrances without doubt. With the perfume Cool Water Night Dive perfumer Jean-Christophe Hérault has succeeded in creating a perfume that is a cut above the rest. Hérault learnt his trade from scratch with Pierre Bourdon, who created a milestone with Cool Water in the history of perfumery a quarter of a century ago. The Eau de Toilette Spray from Davidoff that is currently conquering the market is paying homage to the great master. A clear and sensual perfume for men The new scent is green-oriental, a vital prerequisite for the mysterious aura that surrounds this otherwise cool and composed perfume. The basis of the scent is the wood of the pistachio , an extremely valuable and rarely used raw material that is also known as mastic wood. The precious Eau de Toilette Spray develops opening with a note of fresh fruit and mint that is an ideal match for the sensual woody note. A hint of cashmere adds an oriental component to the mix. The successful composition is rounded off through typically male ingredients such as amber, sage, black pepper, tobacco and musk. And yet, words alone can’t do it justice. Cool Water Night Dive from Davidoff is a clear enticement to get a sniff of it.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum Spray - refillable 30 ml
listings.description: The Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum Spray by Viktor & Rolf is a multi-layered fragrance composition that combines a wealth of floral notes with warm, deep accents. The fragrance opens with a sparkling and invigorating blend of bergamot and green tea, which creates a clear and fresh first impression. Shortly afterwards, an opulent bouquet of precious Sambac jasmine, delicate freesia, precious centifolia rose and exotic orchid unfolds at the heart of the fragrance. This floral diversity is complemented by the delicate sweetness of African orange blossom, giving the creation its unmistakable character. Earthy notes of patchouli and a hint of musk provide a long-lasting and intense base, giving the fragrance a warm and expressive dimension. This composition is bottled in a distinctive, faceted glass bottle in the shape of a garnet, whose pale pink colour elegantly reflects the contents. Its multi-layered nature makes Flowerbomb a suitable companion for everyday wear as well as for special occasions. listings.description: The Spicebomb Eau de Toilette Spray by Viktor & Rolf is a composition based on an exciting interplay of contrasts. Created in 2012 by perfumer Olivier Polge, the fragrance unfolds with a fresh top note of bergamot and grapefruit, which is given a special vibrancy by the accents of pink pepper and elemi. At the heart of the composition, the warmth of cinnamon and saffron meets the intensity of red pepper. This spicy heart note transitions into a base of notes of vetiver, tobacco and white leather, which give the fragrance its deep and masculine character. The eau de toilette is particularly suitable for the cooler seasons and the evening. The experience is rounded off by the iconic bottle in the shape of a hand grenade, which visually emphasises the nature of the fragrance. listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Eau de Parfum Spray Nightvision 50 ml
listings.description: The Spicebomb Nightvision Eau de Parfum Spray by Viktor & Rolf is an intense and multi-faceted fragrance composition that was launched in 2020. The fragrance opens with an exciting top note in which the freshness of grapefruit, lemon and green apple meets an ensemble of warm spices such as cardamom, clove and nutmeg. A hint of chilli provides an unexpected accent. At the heart, an aromatic depth unfolds with notes of lavender, rosemary, clary sage and coriander, which are given a special nuance by mastic resin. The base gives the fragrance its dark and long-lasting character. Here, woody and resinous accords of cedarwood, fir balsam and incense merge with the warmth of Peru balsam and patchouli to create an elegant and masculine signature. This composition differs fundamentally from the eau de toilette of the same name and is particularly recommended for the evening and the colder months of the year. An intense fragrance with an elegant, dark and mysterious character. A complex fragrance pyramid of fresh, spicy, aromatic and woody-resinous notes. The composition differs significantly from Spicebomb Nightvision Eau de Toilette. Ideal for the evening hours and the cooler months of the year.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum Spray Ruby Orchid 30 ml
listings.description: The Flowerbomb Ruby Orchid Eau de Parfum Spray by Viktor & Rolf is a composition that has been enriching the world of fragrances since 2021. The fragrance unfolds with a fruity top note of vine peach and freesia, which creates a lively opening. At the heart of the creation is a floral bouquet that combines jasmine with the eponymous ruby orchid. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm and sweet base note consisting of red vanilla pod and fine bourbon vanilla. This combination of floral, fruity and gourmand elements gives the perfume an intense and sensual character. For a long-lasting presence, the spray can be applied from a short distance to warm areas of skin such as the inside of the wrists or behind the ears. Flowerbomb Ruby Orchid is a fragrance for anyone who appreciates an expressive composition. Sensual, floral-fruity fragrance with gourmand notes. Composition of vine peach, ruby orchid and bourbon vanilla. An intense eau de parfum from 2021. It is particularly suitable for spring and daytime wear.

listings.description: The Spicebomb Night Vision by Viktor & Rolf is an eau de toilette that unfolds a multi-faceted composition of freshness and spice. The opening is characterised by a tangy blend of green mandarin, grapefruit, bergamot and Granny Smith apple, which is refined with a hint of cardamom. The heart of the fragrance develops into a warm complex of intense spices such as chilli and saffron, complemented by clary sage, rosemary and lavandin. The base rounds off the olfactory experience with deep, masculine accords of leather, tobacco and a black spice complex. The creation is presented in the characteristic grenade-shaped bottle, which visually emphasises the energetic signature of the fragrance in a green and black look. Fragrance character: Fresh, spicy and woody Main notes: Green mandarin, chilli, saffron, leather and tobacco Product type: Eau de toilette spray Design: Iconic grenade-shaped bottle in a green and black look

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum Spray Tiger Lily 100 ml
listings.description: The Flowerbomb Tiger Lily Eau de Parfum Spray by Viktor & Rolf, released in 2023, is a floral-fruity composition for women that transports you to a sunny, exotic location. The fragrance opens with a creamy accord of coconut milk, whose gentle sweetness is balanced by the tangy freshness of bergamot. This inviting top note transitions into an opulent floral heart. The eponymous tiger lily takes centre stage here, lending the fragrance a striking, wild facet and accompanied by delicate jasmine and freesia. This bouquet creates a multi-layered floral depth. The composition finds its warm conclusion in the base note. A juicy mango accord provides a fruity sweetness that blends harmoniously with the resinous warmth of benzoin. The overall result is a sunny and warm fragrance with an unmistakable solar character. Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity, Solar Head note: coconut milk, bergamot Heart note: tiger lily, jasmine, freesia Base note: mango, benzoin Fragrance character: Warm, sunny, exotic

listings.description: The Eau de Rochas Eau de Toilette is a classic fragrance that has been a favourite since its launch in 1970. This composition pays homage to the invigorating freshness of waterfalls and unspoilt nature. The fragrance opens with a sparkling combination of mandarin, bergamot and lemon, which creates a clear and refreshing first impression. At the heart, a bouquet of narcissus, jasmine and rose unfolds, giving the fragrance a subtle floral depth. The base note rounds off the experience with oakmoss, myrrh and vetiver, leaving an earthy, slightly woody signature on the skin. The eau de toilette is presented in an elegant glass bottle, whose textured surface is reminiscent of flowing water and also visually reflects the fragrance experience. Fragrance direction: Citrus-fresh Head note: mandarin, bergamot, lemon Heart note: narcissus, jasmine, rose Base note: oakmoss, myrrh, vetiver Character: Invigorating and elegant

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: With Intuition Eau de Parfum Spray, Aramis presents a modern evolution of the traditional art of fragrance, which is technically categorised as Woody Green Neo-Fougère. Launched in 2025, this creation skilfully combines green accents with a woody depth and stands for contemporary elegance. The olfactory opening is characterised by a crisp grapefruit note that lends the fragrance an immediate, citrusy clarity. Aromatic lavender then unfolds at the centre of the composition, creating a harmonious link to the more complex base notes as a classic element. The foundation of earthy vetiver and the special Cuirissima LXR, an exclusive accord that creates a warm and leathery signature, is particularly influential for the character of the perfume. Accompanying nuances of patchouli, amber and orris round off the fragrance experience and lend it a subtle persistence. Visually, the purity of the fragrance is reflected in a slim, cylindrical bottle made of transparent glass, which reveals the clear liquid. A silver cap and vertical lettering on the front complete the minimalist design. The projection of the eau de parfum changes from an initial freshness to a subtle, body-hugging warmth as it is worn. Fragrance family: Woody Green Neo-Fougère with woody and green facets. Top notes of tangy grapefruit and heart notes with aromatic lavender. Base note with earthy vetiver and exclusive Cuirissima LXR leather accord. Minimalist, cylindrical glass bottle with silver cap. Evolution from citrusy freshness to warm, leathery depth.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml

listings.description: L'Air du Temps by Nina Ricci is an iconic fragrance classic that was created by perfumer Francis Fabron in 1948. This floral-spicy composition unfolds with a lively top note of Italian bergamot, spicy clove oil, neroli and a hint of peach. At the heart of the creation is a harmonious bouquet of rose centifolia, jasmine from Grasse and gardenia, which is given a special sophistication by ylang-ylang and cloves. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with warm, gentle accords of sandalwood, iris, musk and cedarwood, giving the perfume a long-lasting depth. The fragrance is presented in an elegantly curved glass bottle with a cap crowned by two embracing doves - a timeless symbol of peace and love. With its elegant and feminine aura, L'Air du Temps is a versatile companion for any occasion. A timeless, floral-spicy fragrance classic. Composition of carnation, rose, jasmine and sandalwood. On the market since 2024 and as an interesting perfume as popular as tried-and-tested products. The effect of spices in combination with fruits and patchouli! listings.description: The Moschino Toy 2 Eau de Parfum Spray, created by perfumers Alberto Morillas and Fabrice Pellegrin, was launched in 2018. This fragrance for women belongs to the floral-woody musk family and has a multi-layered character. It opens with a lively top note of juicy mandarin and crisp Granny Smith apple, accompanied by the floral elegance of magnolia. At the heart of the composition, the delicacy of peony meets pure jasmine petals, whilst white currant adds a surprisingly fruity facet. The base note anchors the fragrance with warm tones. Here, sandalwood and amberwood combine with the gentle clarity of musk to create a harmonious finish. The Eau de Parfum is presented in a distinctive bottle that echoes the iconic shape of a teddy bear. A fragrance for women from the floral-woody musk family A lively opening with mandarin, apple and magnolia A warm base note of sandalwood, amberwood and musk Iconic bottle in an unmistakable teddy bear design

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy Boy Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Moschino’s Toy Boy Eau de Parfum Spray is a fragrance full of contrasts and playful elegance. Created by perfumer Yann Vasnier, this composition belongs to the spicy-woody fragrance family and surprises with floral and fruity notes. The opening unfolds with a lively blend of Italian bergamot, pear and the subtle heat of pink pepper and Indonesian nutmeg. This is followed by the heart note, in which a bouquet of magnolia, rose absolute and flax blossom blends with the spicy warmth of clove. The base note leaves a lasting impression, creating a warm, earthy depth with Haitian vetiver, sandalwood and Ambermax®. The fragrance’s distinctive character is also reflected in the bottle’s design: a black teddy bear that serves as an ironic statement, emphasising the dynamic side of the creation. Fragrance family: Spicy-woody with floral and fruity accents Top note: A lively opening with Italian bergamot, pear and pink pepper Heart note: Floral notes of magnolia and rose meet spicy clove Base note: A warm, long-lasting base of vetiver, sandalwood and Ambermax® Character: Distinctive, dynamic and playful

listings.description: Presented in a playful teddy bear-shaped bottle, whose surface shimmers with a mesmerising mother-of-pearl effect, Moschino Toy 2 Pearl is a modern unisex fragrance from 2023. The composition opens with an invigorating top note of zesty lemon and lemon sorbet, accompanied by a subtle hint of oregano. As the fragrance develops, a heart of floral notes—jasmine and freesia—unfolds, combined with a unique sandy accord that evokes a warm sea breeze. The base is formed by earthy and woody notes of vetiver and cypress, harmoniously rounded off by soft musk. The result is a multi-faceted fragrance that combines fresh, aquatic and floral elements with a subtle warmth. Its elegant yet vibrant character makes it a truly special fragrance experience. listings.rawTitle: Moschino Fresh Couture Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: With a design that deliberately plays on the aesthetics of everyday objects, Fresh Couture Eau de Toilette comes in the form of a conventional spray bottle for cleaning products. Behind this humorous and ironic façade, with its transparent blue contents, lies a carefully crafted fragrance composition from the floral-woody family. Launched in 2015, the fragrance opens with a fresh top note, in which accords of bergamot and mandarin blend with the exotic notes of ylang-ylang. As the fragrance develops, a fruity yet floral heart comes to the fore, combining sweet hints of raspberry with the elegance of white peony and osmanthus. This perfume, manufactured in Italy, is sensually rounded off by a base note of light woods, white patchouli and ambroxan. This combination lends the fragrance a modern character that emphasises the deliberate contrast between the unassuming bottle and the high-quality contents. The base note anchors the composition with earthy Haitian vetiver and the modern, warm accents of Ambermax and Sylkolide, which ensure a memorable finish. The bottle itself is an unmistakable design statement, featuring Moschino’s iconic teddy bear motif in elegant black. listings.rawTitle: Moschino Forever Sailing Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Forever Sailing Eau de Toilette Spray by Moschino manifests on the skin as a pleasantly fresh scent and is therefore the perfect perfume for spring and summer. A creation with maritime accents and a sophisticated finish of sensual woody notes. The perfume begins with a splash and refreshes with a clear, soul stimulating note of mint. Lemon primofiore and juicy grapefruit ensure a tingling breeze . Thus the Forever Sailing Eau de Toilette Spray by Moschino conveys a pleasant feeling of airy freedom to the wearer. A feeling like a beach day by the sea where you can see as far as the horizon. The necessary grounding is achieved by lavender and juniper. The fragrance collection is based on Sex Appeal and love of life. Whether stylish, sensual or sexy, this perfume is there to give that moment of insouciance, a moment of pure enjoyment , which luxury along can give, to enjoy life to the fullest. The Eau de Toilette Spray Forever Sailing is by the brand founded in the Italian fashion market in 1983. Clothing, accessories and fragrances symbolise the typical Moschino style, which is at once fresh and unconventional, as well as exceptionally luxurious.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Explorer Eau de Parfum Spray by Montblanc is a warm woody fragrance for men that is refined with spirited aromatic spices. With elegant Akigalawood and spirited pepper The Explorer Eau de Parfum Spray by Montblanc is a charismatic men's fragrance with an elegant oriental undertone and energising spices. The creation initially refreshes you when you spray it on with an invigorating blend of bergamot, hot pink pepper and clary sage. The heart note is characterised by a masculine leather nuance , which is complemented by earthy Haitian vetiver grass. The base is given an exotic flair by Indonesian patchouli leaves. The warm scent of Akigalawood, gentle ambroxan and cocoa fruits add a mild, subliminal sweetness to the bouquet. When you hear the name "Montblanc", you first think of stylish writing instruments and elegant leather goods, but the company, which originally came from Germany, has also launched more than 25 perfumes on the market since 2001. Like all of its products, the fragrances also exude a classic elegance - the Explorer Eau de Parfum Spray, available since 2019 and created in collaboration with master perfumers Olivier Pescheux and Antoine Maisondieu, is no exception.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Elixir Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: The Montblanc Legend Elixir perfume is a highly concentrated amber-fougère fragrance with a long-lasting presence throughout the day. Immediately after spraying, a fresh combination of bergamot, lavender and pink pepper opens the fragrance experience and offers an invigorating start to the morning. As the fragrance progresses, the heart notes of floral iris and fruity pomarose™ reveal a profound facet that emphasises a self-confident charisma in everyday life. Finally, warm base notes such as vanilla, amber woods and incense resin round off the composition and leave a striking, memorable aura that is particularly suitable for evening occasions or important dates. The silver-coloured, shiny metallic bottle discreetly reflects the elegant nature of the contents. Thanks to the high fragrance concentration, just a few sprays are enough to achieve an intense olfactory experience, making it economical and uncomplicated to use. listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: With the fresh, woody Eau de Parfum Spray Legend, the Hamburg-based luxury label Montblanc is continuing its line of 'legendary' men's fragrances, which have long since achieved cult status. Launched in 2020, the fragrance is, like its predecessors, a creation by star perfumer Olivier Pescheux . Following the fresh fougère composition from 2011, the casually elegant Spirit version presented in 2016 and the seductively sensual Night version presented in 2018, a creation with an emphatically intense signature and sensual, charming orientation is now being presented. This gives the Eau de Parfum Spray Legend by Montblanc impressive longevity and particularly good sillage. An exclusive, successful perfume with innovative charm The new version of Montblanc Legend also captivates with the familiar and successful accord with notes of beguilingly fragrant jasmine and soft, green moss, underlaid with sweet and tart nuances of bergamot. However, the Eau de Parfum Spray from 2020 expands the exquisite fragrance sequence with green, aromatic facets of dewy violet leaves and seductively graceful magnolia. Strong accents of resinous wood and fresh, soft leather add irresistibly elegant nuances to the composition. Lovers of the original perfume will also find the original notes in this excitingly modern fragrance and yet be delighted by the deep radiance of the characterful new creation.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Platinum Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Anyone who first thinks of high-quality writing instruments when they hear the name Montblanc is not entirely wrong: in fact, the Explorer Platinum men's fragrance also comes from the portfolio of the famous Swiss luxury brand. Perfume lovers have known Montblanc for more than two decades. In 2001, a separate perfume range, "Presence", was added to the already well-developed brand portfolio of luxury accessories such as briefcases, jewellery and wristwatches. The Explorer perfume range was launched in 2019 with the perfume of the same name, which quickly became very popular . With Explorer Platinum Eau de Parfum Spray, Montblanc has launched a fragrance that bridges the gap between spicy and sweet woody notes - a perfume that is appreciated for its distinctive originality. With a top note of violet leaf and a heart note of aromatic-balsamic clary sage, the men's fragrance gains sweetness and freshness. The eau de parfum spray is rounded off with a base note of cedar wood, which carries and summarises the composition with its dark depth. Explorer Platinum Eau de Parfum Spray was created by three well-known perfume artists: the highly experienced Fabrice Pellegrin, who has already worked for a number of major perfume houses from Dior to Gaultier, Bruno Jovanovicz (e.g. Armani, Lagerfeld) and Nathalie Lorsson, whose list of previous activities also reads like a Who's Who of famous perfume brands. The perfume is supplied in a high-quality silver bottle in the typical Explorer look.

listings.description: The Libre Eau de Parfum Spray by Yves Saint Laurent is a floral fragrance composition presented in a glass flacon designed as a piece of jewellery. At the centre of the fragrance is the interplay of French lavender and Moroccan orange blossom, complemented by musky accords. The composition opens with notes of bergamot and mandarin before moving into a heart of lavender and orange blossom. A base of vanilla bourbon, heliotrope and amber rounds off the fragrance experience. The asymmetrical bottle with its gold-coloured chains and the iconic Cassandre logo combines classic couture elements with modern aesthetics. A special focus is placed on the sustainable concept: the fragrance is refillable, which is a resource-saving alternative to buying a new one. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum Spray 40 ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum is a composition based on the interplay of fresh and woody notes. The fragrance opens with a clear combination of bergamot, ginger and apple, which is complemented by aldehydes. Aromatic nuances of sage, juniper and geranium unfold in the heart, giving the perfume its fougère character. The base anchors the creation with warm and earthy tones of cedarwood, vetiver and amberwood, rounded off by the depth of incense and tonka bean. The fragrance is characterised by a long-lasting presence. Its fragrance progression remains remarkably stable for hours, giving it a straightforward character. Fragrance direction: Aromatic fougère Character: Fresh, spicy, woody Top notes: bergamot, ginger, apple Special feature: Long-lasting with stable fragrance development

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium is an eau de parfum spray that fascinates with its contrasting composition and energetic character. The fragrance initially unfolds with a sparkling freshness of pear accords and pink pepper, which gently leads into a floral heart. The heart note combines the delicacy of white flowers such as jasmine and orange blossom with the unmistakable aroma of black coffee, giving the composition a special depth and lively tension. The base note forms a warm and sensual finish: Intense vanilla meets woody nuances of patchouli and cedar, leaving a long-lasting impression. This multi-layered fragrance emphasises a self-confident charisma. The iconic bottle is presented in a matching deep black colour, enhanced with a sparkling glitter finish that reflects the glamorous and mysterious side of the perfume. An eau de parfum with a warm, spicy and floral character. A composition of notes of black coffee, white flowers and vanilla. Intense and long-lasting fragrance character. Presented in an iconic, glittering black bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Spray Berry Crush 30 ml
listings.description: The Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Spray Berry Crush presents itself as a fruity-floral reinterpretation of the well-known Libre signature. Juicy raspberries open the composition in the top note and give the fragrance a lively, berry character. A creamy coconut note unfolds in the heart, bringing a gentle warmth to the arrangement. The base note combines classic diva lavender from France with Moroccan orange blossom and Madagascan vanilla, creating a harmonious balance between freshness and sensuality. This fragrance is characterised by a higher concentration of perfume oils, which can ensure a long-lasting presence on the skin. The bottle picks up on the berry theme visually and comes in vibrant red tones reminiscent of ripe fruit. The design retains the elegant, slim shape of a dinner jacket, accentuated by the iconic, gold-coloured Cassandre logo that wraps around the glass bottle. An asymmetrical, black cap with golden details completes the jewel-like appearance. Compared to other variants in the line, the focus here is clearly on the fruity accents, while the lavender note remains somewhat more subtle in the background. Fragrance family: Fruity-floral with warm undertones. Main notes: Raspberry, creamy coconut, lavender and vanilla. Character: A fruitier, modern interpretation of the classic Libre fragrance. Design: Elegant glass bottle in berry red tones with gold logo detail. Concentration: Eau de Parfum for an intense fragrance experience.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L'Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 60 ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent presents La Nuit De L'Homme, an eau de toilette spray that is characterised by its exciting contrasts and elegant radiance. The fragrance composition begins with the intense spiciness of cardamom in the top note, which is balanced by the sparkling freshness of bergamot and leaves an invigorating first impression. At the heart of the fragrance, a striking combination of aromatic lavender and powerful cedarwood unfolds, giving the perfume a clear, woody structure and depth. The base note forms the final note and creates a lasting impression: this is where the earthy nuances of vetiver meet the warm spice of caraway. listings.description: The Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau de Parfum Spray offers an intense fragrance experience for special moments, whether during the day or in the evening. The balanced formulation blends gently with the skin, allowing it to develop a unique, distinctive scent signature. listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Girl Eau de Toilette 30 ml
listings.description: Since its launch in the 1990s, this fragrance has established itself as a modern classic, renowned for its lively energy and carefree charm. The olfactory journey begins with a distinctly invigorating top note, in which the citrus freshness of bergamot and mandarin blends with the cool, crisp nuance of green mint. This invigorating opening sets the stage for a multifaceted heart, dominated by a lush bouquet of jasmine, rose and honeysuckle, whilst subtle tea accords lend an intriguing depth. The composition rounds off with a warm base of musk, ambergris and wild heather, lending the eau de toilette a gentle, lingering quality. The bottle’s design reflects the simplicity of its contents: A transparent, rectangular glass bottle with rounded corners reveals the slightly yellowish liquid. The appearance is enhanced by a cylindrical, silver-coloured cap and the distinctive red lettering on the front. As a floral-fruity creation, this spray offers a balanced blend of freshness and warmth that embodies the signature style of the Tommy Hilfiger brand. Fragrance family: Floral-fruity composition with a fresh character. Top notes: A combination of bergamot, mandarin and spearmint. Heart notes: A floral bouquet of jasmine, rose, honeysuckle and tea accords. Base note: A warm finish with musk, ambergris and wild heather. Bottle: Transparent, rectangular design with a silver cap and red lettering.

listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Since its launch in 1995, Tommy Eau de Toilette Spray has epitomised a modern, aromatic classic. The composition starts with an invigorating freshness characterised by mint, lavender and tangy grapefruit, while bergamot provides a citrusy accent. An interesting heart note develops as the fragrance progresses, combining fruity Granny Smith apples and cranberries with the spice of cinnamon and nutmeg. This interplay is complemented by floral aspects of cactus blossom and rose. A warm and lasting finish is provided by the base note, which combines elements such as driftwood, maple and poplar with the softness of cotton and ambergris. This fragrance signature captures the atmosphere of a road trip through vast landscapes and symbolises independence. Visually, the rectangular, slightly rounded glass bottle with its "HILFIGER" and "EST. 1985" engravings on the sides and the blue lettering emphasise the timeless character of the brand. Fragrance: Fresh and aromatic with woody undertones. Head note: A combination of mint, lavender, grapefruit and bergamot. Heart note: Fruity accents of apple and cranberry meet cinnamon and cactus blossom. Base note: Warm nuances of driftwood, maple, poplar and cotton. Design: Classic glass bottle with silver cap and brand engraving.

Fruity and floral notes blend to create a harmonious fragrance experience that leaves a pleasant lightness on the skin. Hints of apple blossom and mandarin open the fragrance, ensuring an invigorating start to the day. As the fragrance develops, floral notes such as jasmine unfold, lending the creation a timeless elegance. A base of cedarwood rounds the composition off, lending the scent a gentle depth. Thanks to its balanced formulation, the perfume can be worn effortlessly on a wide variety of occasions, whether at the office or in your free time. Just a few sprays are enough to create a long-lasting scent that subtly and unobtrusively enhances your personal presence. A fruity-floral fragrance composition for a pleasant sense of lightness in everyday life Top notes of apple blossom and mandarin offer an invigorating opening Floral heart notes and a woody base lend timeless elegance Versatile for both professional and personal occasions Just a few sprays are enough for a long-lasting scent

listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Impact Together Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Tommy Hilfiger developed the eponymous brand with a connection to the USA in 1985. Since then, his focus has been on sporty and elegant products. Initially designing only fashion, he introduced his first perfume for men, "Tommy", in 1994. It remains a popular classic to this day and is considered a quality product on which his other fragrances are based. This also applies to the newly released Impact Together Eau de Toilette Spray. It is a men's perfume that elegantly emphasises nonchalance as a daytime fragrance and powerfully brings robust masculinity to the fore with intense spicy components. Tommy Hilfiger Impact Together for the purposeful, modern man This eau de toilette spray opens with an exciting tingle in the nose and a balsamic, spicy top note with pepper. Slightly spicy, the perfume radiates powerful energy - perfect for a successful, motivated start to the day . After a few moments, a woody and earthy note follows, paired with floral and smoky nuances of mugwort and sage. In combination, these heart notes give men a strongly masculine yet slightly playful aura that inspires and energises. A fascinating and motivating aroma emanates from vetiver as a base note. In Tommy Hilfiger Impact Together Eau de Toilette Spray, it exudes strongly smoky and woody fragrance components with undertones of earthy accents and a fine chocolate flavour. This creates an oriental odeur touch that beguiles the senses and creates a lasting, attractive impression .

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The power within. Burberry Goddess tells a story of self-discovery. The new campaign follows Emma Mackey and a pride of lionesses. With her confident, strong, friendly presence, Emma epitomises the spirit of Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum. This unique fragrance has a vegan formulation led by a powerful vanilla trio. Top notes of vanilla infusion with woody nuances, heart notes of vanilla caviar with luscious sweetness and base notes of vanilla absolute enriched with luminous lavender. Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum is contained in an elegant square bottle designed to be refilled. The refill is available separately. The pale pink packaging, decorated with a golden medallion, is a nod to the brand's rich tradition.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: In 2022, Burberry introduces the Eau de Parfum Spray Hero. The fragrance is sweet and woody and is intended for men. Created by perfumer Aurélien Guichard, however, it does not need a pyramid to develop its rather long-lasting presence. Pine needles meet benzoin, atlas cedar combines with Himalayan cedar and Virginia cedar before incense gently envelops everything. The composition of the Eau de Parfum Spray Hero not only has sweet and woody sides, but also resinous elements that prevent the fragrance from becoming too sweet. With Hero, Burberry presents an eau de parfum spray that breaks away a little from the label's well-known British understatement. Modern and casual, elegant Sweet men's fragrances are rarely found at Burberry, which makes this composition all the more exciting. Gentlemen who like it sweet and slightly resinous will get their money's worth with Hero. Especially because the fragrance develops into a really woody drydown over time. Burberry has once again proven that it has a good feel for elegant and timeless trends. And although the fragrance is sweet, it is also masculine , but with a conscious nonchalance , and does not impose itself, after all, it is an eau de parfum spray for the city, where it is often far too crowded and you don't want to wear expansive fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray Refillable / 30 ml
listings.description: Discover the divine essence of femininity with the exquisite Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray from Burberry. This extraordinary perfume is a tribute to the timeless elegance and inner strength of every woman. Its skilfully crafted bottle, which reflects the iconic Burberry design, conceals a fragrance that combines sensuality and sophistication in perfect harmony. Exclusive perfume from Burberry The olfactory experience begins with a gentle breeze of lavender in the top note. This calming opening envelops you in an aura of serenity and freshness, reminiscent of sun-soaked lavender fields in Provence. It is the perfect introduction to a fragrance journey that will enchant your senses. A seductive composition of warm, sweet vanilla unfolds at the heart of Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray. This heart note gives the fragrance a creamy depth and a subtle sweetness reminiscent of golden honey and sun-warmed skin. The vanilla caresses your senses and envelops you in an aura of comfort and sensuality. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with earthy, sensual patchouli. This powerful note gives the perfume depth and character, while at the same time creating a mysterious, almost mystical aura. The patchouli is reminiscent of exotic lands and lends the fragrance an irresistible allure that lingers for a long time. Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray is more than just a fragrance - it is an experience, a transformation. With its intense formulation, the fragrance lasts all day and into the night, perfect for special occasions or when you just want to feel like a goddess.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Burberry Hero is an eau de toilette spray for men launched in 2021. The fragrance is spicy and woody , the straightforward bottle was designed by Riccardo Tisci. Perfumer Aurèlien Guichard composed Hero without a fragrance pyramid. He blends cedar from Virginia, the Atlas Mountains and the Himalayas with spicy black pepper, aromatic juniper and resinous bergamot. Designed in this way, the Burberry Eau de Toilette Spray is masculine but not overpowering, elegant and expressive, yet at the same time refined and discreet. It is the perfect fragrance for everyday wear, where the well-groomed man of today wants to smell good but not overpowering. These heroes also score points in everyday life Hero is a men's fragrance that doesn't need a costume. Sporty and casual , elegant and wearable , the ideal companion for jeans and boots as well as a suit, the Hero eau de toilette spray from Burberry is just like the fashion of the popular British label. A touch of luxury that is evident in the quality and versatility, which does not play itself into the foreground, but is simply there. Very British, very gentlemanly. This fragrance is a real must-have, not just for die-hard Burberry fans, but for anyone who likes a strong yet discreet scent.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Perfume 150 ml
listings.description: With the Burberry Hero fragrance, the British designer house continues the success story of the eponymous fragrance range. The creation from 2024 combines balsamic, warm notes with smoky accents and a masculine, woody base . The result is a men's fragrance with a character that is as modern as it is elegant. Modern composition with a classic base The Burberry Hero fragrance opens with a top note dominated by cypriol oil. It sets a woody, earthy accent that is also reminiscent of leather. In the background, the heart note forms an exciting contrast with the warm, sweet and woody scent of amyris oil. The crowning glory of the composition is the base note of cedarwood, a classic ingredient for high-quality fragrances. This modern men's fragrance is perfect for making a statement. With its elegant charisma , it is perfect for the evening. It is equally at home at dinner, in a club or at special events. Burberry Hero perfume comes into its own in cooler weather thanks to its balsamic, woody character.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Parfum Intense 50 ml
listings.description: Experience the fascinating world of Burberry with Parfum Intense, an extraordinary eau de parfum from the Hero collection that redefines modern masculinity. In this masterful composition, natural strength and elegance merge to create a fragrance with a strong character that sets new standards in the world of woody men's fragrances. The fresh essence of pine unfolds in the top note right at the beginning, its clear, natural presence immediately evoking memories of a walk through a majestic coniferous forest. This intense freshness transitions seamlessly into the heart note, where the warm, balsamic sweetness of benzoin unfolds and lends the fragrance a seductive depth and oriental sophistication. Parfum Intense Eau de Parfum Spray - powerful elegance in perfection In the harmonious finale, the composition is carried by precious cedarwood, whose warm, woody nuances blend perfectly with the previous notes and create a long-lasting, masculine signature. This balanced fragrance pyramid creates an unmistakable aura of self-confidence and timeless elegance. The modern design of the Hero bottle with its clear lines and striking shape picks up on the strength of character of the fragrance and emphasises its intensity as an eau de parfum spray. This creates a holistic fragrance experience that lingers on the skin for a long time. Parfum Intense from the Hero collection by Burberry is the ideal companion for today's man who values quality and style . As a worthy representative of the renowned Burberry men's fragrances, it impresses both in a business environment and on special occasions with its expressive yet discreet presence.</p

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Elixir Eau de Parfume Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Burberry Her Elixir Eau de Parfume Spray was released in 2022 and enriches the popular Her fragrance range with a fruity gourmand . Its opaque, deep pink bottle cleverly embodies the fragrance's character: intense, sensual and creamy. The smooth, warm accords make it the perfect cosy fragrance for the cool season. However, its cheerful fruitiness gives Her Elixir a special twist . This also makes the fragrance an uncomplicated companion on warm spring days. Her Elixir - the intensifying flanker The fragrance DNA is closely related to the classic Burberry Her, but Her Elixir has a little more of everything: more creaminess, a pronounced powdery note and more powerful berry accords . These fruity notes dominate the eau de parfume spray at first spray. Strawberry and blackberry as the only top notes create a fresh sweetness in the opening. The heart consists of clear, minimalist and elegant pure jasmine. The result is a carefree, feminine fragrance full of sensuality and joie de vivre. In the dry down, the Burberry Eau de Parfume Spray ends with lush accords of warm vanilla and cosy sandalwood and amber - a composition made for women who like to push boundaries. But beware: you'll probably find it hard to save yourself from compliments.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Burberry Her Eau de Toilette Spray is a floral-fresh fragrance with fruity and green influences . The extravagant fragrance composition is suitable for women who want to emphasise their femininity and present themselves with confidence. Here, sensual sounds meet floral and sparkling notes. British model Fran Summers is the face of the perfume's advertising campaign. With her attractive, romantic and equally powerful charisma , she perfectly reflects the current zeitgeist and the direction of this perfume. The Her Eau de Toilette Spray by Burberry whets the appetite for more and envelops every woman in a cheerful, tender and extremely lively aura . A luxurious fragrance that invites you to dream In the top note, green bergamot, blackcurrant and pink pepper initially unfold their loving aromas. Honeysuckle, peony, rose and lily of the valley take the lead in the heart. In the base note, nuances of musk and cedar wood skilfully round off this unmistakable fragrance experience. Due to its lightness, Burberry Her Eau de Toilette Spray is particularly effective in the warmer seasons from spring to autumn . The minimalist and stylishly designed bottle made of solid glass with the atomiser placed on the side sets the scene for this fragrance in an appealing and tasteful way.

The bottle, which comes in a beautiful pale pink, is also an eye-catcher - and is guaranteed to catch the eye in the bathroom at home. An intense, delicious and exclusive perfume for women The top note of Burberry Her Eau de Parfum Intense Spray opens with very striking and fruity extracts of strawberry. The heart note is also fruity, with floral accords dominating, with orange blossom standing out in particular. The base note uses amberwood to give the entire creation a subtle oriental and exotic touch. The overall fragrance, which is both warm and sparkling, is truly unique. The aura of luxury that this creation exudes from the first spritz is unmistakable - also very suitable for special occasions.</p

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Love Eau de Toilette Spray Eau So Sweet 30 ml
listings.description: Daisy Love Eau So Sweet by Marc Jacobs is a fragrance that evokes sweet light-heartedness and youthful optimism. This composition pays homage to life’s carefree moments and captures a playful spirit, inspired by values such as sisterhood and joy. The fragrance opens with a zesty blend of white raspberry, fresh bergamot and crystallised cloudberries, creating a fruity first impression. At the heart, a delicate bouquet of daisy tree petals unfolds, accompanied by a hint of jasmine milk, lending the eau de toilette its floral character. The base note provides a warm and sensual depth, blending sugar musk with elegant white iris wood. As an Eau de Toilette with a long-lasting formula, it is ideal for everyday wear and will particularly appeal to lovers of sweet gourmand notes who are looking for a fragrance signature that is both fresh and warm. Fragrance character: Sweet and fruity with floral and musky gourmand notes. Fragrance composition: A blend of white raspberry, daisy petals and sugar musk. Fragrance type: Long-lasting eau de toilette, ideal for everyday use.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Parfum Spray Just Perfect 30 ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Just Perfect Eau de Parfum adds a fruity, sweet scent to everyday life, leaving a pleasant impression. A fresh opening of strawberry accord, passion fruit, mandarin and raspberry offers a refreshing fragrance experience immediately after spraying. This zesty combination ensures a lively start to the morning. At its heart, the fragrance unfolds a harmonious blend of jasmine sambac, caramel, red apple and orange blossom petals. This heart note lends an elegant aura to your appearance, making it ideal for the office or a relaxed afternoon get-together. The base notes of vanilla absolute and amber sorbet round off the composition and ensure a warm finish. The fragrance thus reliably accompanies you well into the evening. The light blue bottle, with its striking white bow, is a stylish eye-catcher. The practical spray head allows for precise application of the eau de parfum. With its compact 30 ml size, it also fits effortlessly into any bag and offers a simple way to freshen up whilst out and about. listings.rawTitle: Chloé Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray is a modern and elegant interpretation of the classic rose, captured in a floral fragrance. The composition opens with a fresh top note of delicate pink peony, fruity lychee and airy freesia. At the heart of the fragrance, a delicate bouquet of magnolia and lily of the valley unfolds, giving way to a warm base. Notes of cedarwood, amber and a hint of honey lend the perfume its sensual, powdery and characterful finish. The overall result is a light and warm fragrance that combines French charm with a blend of floral notes and lively accents. The romantically designed bottle, inspired by the Chloé Fortune Plissé collection, emphasises the fragrance’s elegance. A silver-plated metal plate and a hand-tied beige bow complete the design. Its timeless appeal was recognised in 2024 with the Austrian Perfume Award in the ‘Classic Women’s Fragrances’ category. A floral fragrance offering a modern interpretation of the rose. A composition of peony, lychee, magnolia and cedarwood. A light, warm and powdery fragrance. An elegant pleated bottle with a hand-tied bow. Awarded “Women’s Classic” at the Austrian Perfume Awards 2024.

In the base, intense oakmoss lends the composition a distinctive, mineral depth and rounds off the fragrance experience. This interplay creates a fragrance that is suitable for both everyday wear and special occasions. The bottle itself reflects the character of the perfume: transparent glass allows a rosé-beige shimmer to shine through, whilst the gold-coloured cap is adorned with a delicate leather strap. A floral chypre fragrance with mineral accents. A composition of fresh freesia, sweet mirabelle plum and intense oakmoss. Embodies a blend of natural elegance and freedom. Presented in a travel-inspired bottle.

The fragrance opens with the floral freshness of freesia, which meets the sweet, fruity nuances of mirabelle plum in the heart note. In the base, intense oakmoss lends the composition a distinctive, mineral depth and rounds off the fragrance experience. This interplay creates a fragrance that is suitable for both everyday wear and special occasions. The bottle itself reflects the character of the perfume: transparent glass allows a rosé-beige shimmer to shine through, whilst the gold-coloured cap is adorned with a delicate leather strap. A floral chypre fragrance with mineral accents. A composition of fresh freesia, sweet mirabelle plum and intense oakmoss. Embodies a blend of natural elegance and freedom. Presented in a travel-inspired bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Love Story Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Love Story is an eau de parfum inspired by a modern romance set in the streets of Paris. The fragrance composition is floral and fresh, opening with a lively top note. Here, neroli and zesty citrus notes of bergamot, grapefruit and lemon meet the gentle sweetness of pear. As the fragrance develops, the heart unfolds: a bouquet of orange blossom, Madagascar jasmine and classic rose. Fruity accents of blackcurrant and peach lend the heart note a distinctive dimension. The fragrance concludes with a warm base of musk, cedar, patchouli and cashmere wood, which lends the fragrance its enduring character. The fragrance is presented in an elegant, delicate golden bottle, whose design emphasises the perfume’s allure. A fresh, floral fragrance A composition with notes of neroli, orange blossom and cedar Inspired by a modern love story in Paris Presented in an elegant, delicate golden bottle

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Le Parfum Eau de Parfum Spray Refillable 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Le Parfum, a fragrance created in France by perfumer Romain Almairac, is an intense interpretation of the classic signature. The opening unfolds with a powerful accord of orange blossom, which immediately exudes a warm presence and appeals to the senses. This is followed in the heart by an essence of rose, which significantly shapes the structure of the fragrance and lends it an elegant character. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a base of vanilla and tonka bean, which lends the Eau de Parfum Spray a certain depth without becoming overly sweet. Visually, the product captivates with its iconic fluted glass bottle, which holds a light golden liquid and is crowned by a silver cap. A beige label and a hand-tied bow in a dark Bordeaux shade around the neck of the bottle add splashes of colour. The entire range is designed to be refillable in 30 ml, 50 ml and 100 ml sizes, promoting the responsible use of resources. For the nuances to unfold over time, we recommend applying it to pulse points such as the neck, décolleté or the insides of the wrists. Fragrance composition: Powerful orange blossom in the top note, combined with rose essence and a base of vanilla and tonka bean. Character: A warm, intense fragrance that makes a statement without being too sweet. Design: Iconic flacon made of ribbed glass with a silver cap and a burgundy bow. Sustainability: The Eau de Parfum spray is designed to be refillable. Origin: Created by perfumer Romain Almairac and manufactured in France.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Nuit d'Egypt 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Nomade Nuit d'Égypte pays homage to the origins of perfumery and offers a modern interpretation of humanity’s first fragrance: kyphi. Created by perfumer Juliette Karagueuzoglou, this composition takes you on a fascinating journey. The fragrance opens with powerful accents of myrrh, which blend harmoniously with the spicy notes of ginger and cinnamon. At the heart, a bouquet of broom blossom nectar and the opulent orange blossom absolute—sourced directly from the Nile Delta—unfolds. Warm, balsamic nuances of cypriol and opoponax round off the heart note, before a soft vanilla note in the base provides a long-lasting finish. The Eau de Parfum consists of 90 per cent ingredients of natural origin. The bottle is adorned with a ribbon in ‘Egyptian Blue’, one of the oldest man-made pigments, which emphasises the fragrance’s refined character. The packaging also consists partly of recycled materials. An amber-floral fragrance with an intense and sophisticated character. A composition featuring notes of myrrh, orange blossom absolute and vanilla. Contains 90 per cent ingredients of natural origin. Inspired by the formula of the ancient Egyptian Kyphi perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Jasmin Naturelle 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Nomade Jasmin Naturelle Eau de Parfum Spray is a fragrance inspired by the beauty of the world. At the heart of this feminine fragrance creation by perfumer Caroline Dumur lies Egyptian jasmine, responsibly hand-picked at sunrise. Its floral note blends in the heart with the gentle accent of date, whilst a base of warm vanilla and sandalwood lends a harmonious depth. The composition unfolds with a floral-spicy character and is characterised by a soft, elegant warmth that avoids any cloying sweetness. The formulation is vegan and consists of 100% naturally derived ingredients, with no artificial colourants. The bottle, in earthy ochre tones with a braided detail around the neck, reflects the fragrance’s cosmopolitan character. A feminine, floral-spicy fragrance A composition with notes of jasmine, date and vanilla Vegan formula made from 100% naturally derived ingredients Free from artificial colourings

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray Lumineuse 50 ml
listings.description: Chloé Lumineuse is an Eau de Parfum created by perfumer Ane Ayo. At the heart of the composition, a full-bodied and complex rose unfolds, elegantly accompanied by velvety notes of Arabian jasmine. A subtle hint of vanilla lends the floral bouquet a special depth, gently underscored by warm amber and balsamic accents. The fragrance’s vegan formula consists of naturally derived fragrances, alcohol and water. The perfume is housed in an elegant, fluted glass bottle in a vintage style. A shiny silver cap and a beige ribbon with a delicate pink stitching adorn the design. The bottle is made from 25% recycled glass and the ribbon from 100% recycled polyester. The perfume is also available as a 150 ml refill pack. A floral fragrance with notes of rose, jasmine and vanilla. Vegan formulation with naturally derived fragrances. Bottle made from recycled materials and available as a refill pack. Elegant, vintage-style bottle design with a distinctive ribbon.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Jardin d’Égypte 30 ml
listings.description: As the third creation in the Nomade Égypte range, the Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Jardin d’Égypte takes you on an olfactory journey to the homeland of the brand’s founder, Gaby Aghion. The composition by perfumer Caroline Dumur captures the atmosphere of a sun-drenched Egyptian garden, where ancient traditions blend with modern lightness. The opening notes immediately surprise with an unusual combination of the rare cassia flower and papyrus, lending the fragrance a green, almost mystical freshness. At the heart, a complex interplay of sweet dates and figs unfolds, meeting a spicy kyphi accord. This ancient incense blend, refined with notes of cinnamon and myrrh, lends a resinous depth that nevertheless remains airy. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm base of creamy sandalwood, ambrette and solarwood, which lingers on the skin for a long time. Visually, the bottle reflects the connection to nature. The distinctive glass bottle, with its rounded shapes, offers a view of the pale yellow liquid. A woven element frames the front, whilst a green band and a matching tassel on the golden cap add splashes of colour. The golden metal element bearing the lettering “NOMADE” completes the elegant look. Fragrance family: Woody-amber with floral and resinous facets. Top notes: Cassie flower and papyrus for a fresh opening. Heart notes: Date, fig and a spicy kyphi accord (cinnamon, myrrh). Base notes: Sandalwood, Solarwood and ambrette provide warmth. Design: Transparent bottle with green details and a braided rim.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Lumière d'Égypte 30 ml
listings.description: The Nomade Lumière d'Égypte Eau de Parfum Spray pays homage to the majestic landscapes of Egypt. Inspired by a journey along the Nile, the fragrance opens with a floral and aquatic accord of blue lotus. This airy freshness gives way to a heart of velvety jasmine notes that unfold a sensual warmth. The fragrance concludes with a rich kyphi accord, a classic composition combining notes of cinnamon bark, sandalwood, myrrh, pink pepper and elemi oil. This blend creates a sophisticated fragrance composition that embodies fresh vegetation and the warmth of the desert. The iconic Nomade bottle emphasises the character of the fragrance with golden accents and an elegant blue-grey ribbon. Fragrance profile: Floral, warm Top note: Blue lotus accord Heart note: Jasmine Base note: Kyphi accord

listings.description: The Chopard Wish Eau de Parfum Spray is a multi-faceted fragrance composition for women that has been inspiring since 1999. Captured in a bottle whose design is reminiscent of an artfully cut diamond, the outer appearance already reflects the character of the contents. The fragrance opens with a playful top note, in which fruity flavours of strawberry, pear and coconut combine with the delicate blossoms of honeysuckle and acacia. The heart of the fragrance then unfolds, a harmonious combination of floral notes such as violet and orchid, which is given a special depth by sweet accents of honey and milk. The base forms a long-lasting and warm finish. This is where creamy notes of vanilla, caramel and toffee meet the woody elegance of sandalwood and the sensuality of amber and incense. The result is a complex and feminine fragrance that leaves behind an unmistakable aura. A multi-faceted fragrance with floral and sweet notes. Iconic bottle in the design of a cut diamond. listings.rawTitle: Laura Biagiotti Forever Eau de Parfum Spray Gold 30 ml
listings.description: The Forever Gold Eau de Parfum Spray complements the fragrances in the Laura Biagiotti Forever collection. The women's fragrance was launched in 2022 and has a floral-spicy presence . Annick Menardo is the nose and gives the eau de parfum spray a top note of plum, blackcurrant buds and Madagascan ginger. For the heart note, she uses the scents of jasmine, tuberose and ylang-ylang. Amber, vanilla and sandalwood form the delicate base. The composition is elegant, wonderfully wearable , feminine and sensual , but not heavy. This makes the Laura Biagiotti Forever Gold Eau de Parfum Spray perfect for spring or warm autumn days and evenings. A touch of Asia Plums and ginger are an extremely popular combination in Asia, both in the world of delicacies and in the world of fragrances. The freshness of the ginger and the slightly tart fruitiness of the plums are subtly framed in the sophisticated fragrance by Laura Biagiotti and exude a wonderful sensuality that is incredibly elegant. In keeping with the fragrance, the Forever Gold bottle is sophisticated and elegant, avoids straight lines, has a subtle golden glass and is also framed by golden elements. The Laura Biagiotti Forever Gold Eau de Parfum Spray is a visual and olfactory delight.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel d'Issey Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Le Sel d'Issey by Issey Miyake is an eau de parfum spray that celebrates the olfactory encounter between sea and earth. This woody-aquatic composition, created by Quentin Bisch, is characterised by its intense and powerful character. It opens with a spicy freshness of ginger, sea salt and incense. In the heart note, a maritime accord of seaweed and sea grass unfolds, accompanied by sand vetiver. The base provides a warm and earthy depth, combining notes of amber, recycled cedarwood and oakmoss. The perfume is certified vegan and its formula consists of 94% ingredients of natural origin. The refillable bottle made from 20% recycled glass underlines the aesthetics of the fragrance with its smoky grey colour gradient and gunmetal-look cap. Woody, aquatic and spicy fragrance Composition of sea salt, ginger, incense, cedarwood and oakmoss Vegan formula with 94% ingredients of natural origin Refillable bottle made from partially recycled glass

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 40 ml
listings.description: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme is an eau de toilette that is characterised by a clear, woody-aquatic signature. It opens with a sparkling freshness of Japanese yuzu, which meets mandarin and lemon flavours. At the heart of the composition, a special combination of aquatic nénuphar notes and the warm spice of nutmeg and cinnamon unfolds. These facets give the fragrance its characteristic depth. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with a powerful blend of tobacco, ambergris, sandalwood and vetiver, leaving a striking impression. The design of the bottle reflects the character of the fragrance: a simple, rectangular glass container with a matt grey metal cap. At the heart of the composition, a special combination of aquatic nénuphar notes and the warm spice of nutmeg and cinnamon unfolds. These facets give the fragrance its characteristic depth. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with a powerful blend of tobacco, ambergris, sandalwood and vetiver, leaving a striking impression. The design of the bottle reflects the character of the fragrance: a simple, rectangular glass container with a matt grey metal cap. The product is available in different sizes and there is a refill bottle that is only compatible with the bottles labelled "RECHARGEABLE". A fragrance from the woody-aquatic fragrance family. Composition of fresh yuzu, spicy nutmeg and warm sandalwood. Presented in a clear, minimalist glass bottle. Available as an eau de toilette in 75 ml, 125 ml and 200 ml sizes.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel d'Issey Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The Issey Miyake Le Sel D'Issey Eau de Parfum combines fresh, nature-inspired fragrance accords into a minimalist composition for everyday use. The fragrance is presented in an elegant, cylindrical glass bottle with a subtle colour gradient. The top notes of yuzu, bergamot and lemon create a crisp opening that evokes a revitalising sensation in the morning. This is followed by a spicy-floral heart note of cinnamon, geranium, lily of the valley and saffron, which unfolds its aromas and lends the fragrance profile a pleasant depth. Woody notes of musk, cedar and sandalwood, combined with Sichuan pepper and fir balsam, form the base, ensuring a long-lasting presence throughout the day. Thanks to its aquatic character, the fragrance can be worn in a variety of ways throughout all four seasons. For the fragrance to develop to its full potential, it is best to spray the perfume directly onto warm areas of skin such as the wrists or chest; however, those with sensitive skin should avoid direct skin contact. Avoiding light-coloured garments and thin fabrics when spraying will help protect the textiles. A minimalist, aquatic fragrance composition for versatile everyday use Top notes of yuzu and lemon for a fresh opening A woody-spicy base note ensures a long-lasting scent Suitable for wear all year round, in all four seasons Elegant bottle design with a subtle colour gradient

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Toilette Spray is the first fragrance from the House of Issey Miyake and a timeless composition inspired by the purity of water. Developed by perfumer Jacques Cavallier, this women's fragrance belongs to the family of floral-aquatic creations. The fragrance experience begins with a clear top note in which lotus and rose combine to create a light, transparent aura. At the heart, an opulent bouquet of lilies and an arrangement of fresh flowers unfolds, giving the fragrance its characteristic floral depth. The base note of precious woods provides a warm and lasting finish that harmoniously rounds off the composition. Facets of freesia, calone and musk emphasise the unmistakable aquatic character and lend the eau de toilette a sensual yet unobtrusive presence. The slim, conical bottle, whose shape is reminiscent of a drop of water, reflects the essence of the fragrance. Fragrance direction: Floral-aquatic Head note: lotus, rose Heart note: lily, fresh flowers Base note: Precious woods Character: Timeless, clear, sensual

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray Intense Wood&Wood 50 ml
listings.description: L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme Wood&Wood by Issey Miyake is an ode to the multifaceted power of nature, captured in a woody, citrusy fragrance. This intense composition from 2019 unfolds as an olfactory journey through the forest, revealing its depth with every spray. The opening is an invigorating combination of tangy grapefruit, which meets the spicy warmth of cardamom and the resinous aroma of elemi for a fresh first impression. At the heart of the fragrance is a striking duo of Virginia cedar and sandalwood. These powerful woods are complemented by a subtle apricot accent and the complexity of ambroxan, giving the heart note an unexpected softness. The base note anchors the experience with earthy notes of patchouli and Haitian vetiver. Additional woody accords and a hint of musk round off the Eau de Parfum Spray Intense and give it a long-lasting, present character that reflects the minimalist and modern style of the brand. listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum Spray Intense 30 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the infinite power and depth of the ocean, Issey Miyake presents L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum Spray Intense. This refillable women's fragrance unfolds an intense floral-aquatic signature, conceived by perfumer Amandine Clerc-Marie as a bold and innovative composition. At the heart of the fragrance is a special Posidonia accord that evokes the vast, vibrant underwater meadows and gives the perfume its unique character. This aquatic note is complemented by exotic ylang-ylang in the heart note, while a base of warm vanilla provides a sensual depth. The formula is vegan-certified and consists of 91% ingredients of natural origin. The design of the bottle also pays homage to nature: the silver-coloured cap imitates metallic water reflections and, as a patented innovation, is made entirely from wood, thus avoiding the use of plastic. As a sign of conscious use of resources, the bottle is refillable for the first time. listings.description: Happiness by Betty Barclay is a fragrance that lives up to its name. It exudes pure happiness and lightness from the very first spritz. Enjoy happiness with Betty Barclay Happiness What would a special moment be without the right fragrance to accompany it? "Arm" yourself for the real moments of happiness with Betty Barclay Happiness. It can also wonderfully revitalise a sometimes dreary everyday routine. Sniff the accords of delicate pear, intense apple and distinctive blackcurrant, which make up the fruity side. All the elements play their part in creating a potpourri of femininity, which is perfectly rounded off with a warm hint of vanilla. The eau de toilette spray also comes in a pretty gold and pink bottle and matching, feminine packaging that makes it ready to give as a gift. Even for you alone!

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Idôle Eau de Parfum Spray 25 ml
listings.description: The Idôle Eau de Parfum Spray by Lancôme is a floral fragrance creation that is self-confident and modern. Rose unfolds at the heart of the composition, accompanied by the presence of jasmine. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a clear chypre-white accord that creates a powdery and musky base. This fragrance was developed by three talented perfumers from different continents who combined their perspectives to create a harmonious essence. The perfume is bottled in a remarkably slim bottle whose design is just as contemporary as the fragrance itself. The bottle is also refillable and therefore supports the conscious use of resources. Floral composition with rose, jasmine and a chypre-white accord. Developed by three perfumers from three different continents. Modern and particularly flat, refillable bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La vie est belle Eau de Parfum Spray Vanille Nude 30 ml
listings.description: Lancôme's La Vie Est Belle Vanille Nude Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition characterised by warmth and elegance. It opens with sunny jasmine Grandiflorum Solaire, whose flowers come from sustainable sources in the French region of Grasse and add a floral lightness. At the heart of the fragrance composition, the full flavour of frosted vanilla bourbon unfolds, which is also sustainably sourced from Madagascar and lends the fragrance a special depth. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a base of creamy white musk and soft sandalwood, which provides a delicate finish. The combination of these selected notes results in a sensual yet delicate fragrance character. This creation was developed by perfumers Anne Flipo and Dominique Ropion. The fragrance is presented in the typical bottle for the range, which is designed in a powdery pink colour for this edition and decorated with a glittering ribbon. A warm, floral fragrance character with a creamy finish. Composition of solar jasmine, frosted vanilla bourbon and white musk. Created by the renowned perfumers Anne Flipo and Dominique Ropion. Presented in the iconic bottle in a delicate, powdery pink shade.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Trésor Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: The Lancôme Trésor Eau de Parfum Spray is characterised by its subtle and romantic fragrance composition, which conveys a feeling of warmth. It opens with delicate notes of rose petals that combine with apricot and peach blossom. At the heart of the composition, an elegant bouquet of iris, lily of the valley and heliotrope unfolds, gently rounded off with a hint of vanilla. A base of sandalwood, musk and amber lends the fragrance a long-lasting, powdery depth. Created by perfumer Sophia Grojsman, Trésor is a timeless classic that harmoniously combines fruity, floral and woody accords. The bottle itself is modelled on a precious piece of jewellery with a faceted design that catches and reflects the light in a special way, while a black ring on the cap adds an elegant accent. A floral-powdery fragrance with fruity and woody accents. Composition of rose petals, iris, peach and sandalwood. Created by the perfumer Sophia Grojsman. Presented in a bottle modelled on a piece of polished jewellery.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La vie est belle Eau de Parfum Spray L'Elixir Very Cherry 10 ml
listings.description: Lancôme’s La Vie Est Belle L’Elixir Very Cherry Eau de Parfum is a reliable companion throughout the day with its fruity-woody composition. The top note of black cherry offers a crisp fragrance experience that ensures an immediate, vibrant start to your morning. As the fragrance develops, violet leaves, iris, sambac jasmine and Damask rose unfold into a floral bouquet that elegantly enhances your presence on special occasions or in the office. Finally, the base notes of warm oud, vanilla, patchouli, cocoa butter, soft leather and cedarwood gently blend with your skin. This deep combination gives the fragrance remarkable longevity, meaning you won’t need to reapply it even on long evenings. The handy 30-ml bottle fits effortlessly into any handbag, making it easy to carry with you throughout the day. Simply spray the eau de parfum onto clean skin and allow it to dry briefly to experience the full development of the fragrance notes. A fruity-floral fragrance composition with a distinctive top note of black cherry Long-lasting wear for a sustained fragrance experience without the need for reapplication A warm base note of oud, vanilla and cedarwood blends gently with the skin The compact 30 ml size is ideal for hassle-free everyday use

The career of the famous fashion designer developed continuously. It began in the mid-1950s, when Karl Lagerfeld started working for famous names in the fashion world. His white powdered plait, Kent collar and sunglasses were his very personal trademarks. Karl Hamburg Alster - a striking eau de toilette spray Karl Hamburg Alster is the new eau de toilette spray for the style-conscious gentleman who knows what he wants. This fragrance contains a combination of mint and mandarin flavours in the top note. The heart note of Karl Hamburg Alster is restrained and elegant with the scent of freesia, sage and lavender. The base note is dark and mysterious with notes of moss, wood and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Les Parfums Matières Eau de Toilette Spray Bois d'Ambre 50 ml
listings.description: Each and every one of us probably has the desire to appear attractive and appealing to our fellow human beings. This is confirmed by a quote from Karl Lagerfeld: "I think perfume must always have something intensely sensual about it. You don't just wear a perfume to smell nice, but to feel beautiful and desirable." The jack-of-all-trades Lagerfeld has not only created exclusive fashion, but also exquisite fragrances for men and women. These include the men's fragrance Les Parfums Matières - Eau de Toilette Spray Bois d'Ambre . Les Parfums Matières has transformed this aromatic fragrance into a new perfume line. Full of charm, the sensual fragrance envelops its wearer. The Karl Lagerfeld Eau de Toilette Spray Bois d'Ambre combines a high-contrast potpourri of warm, powerful woody tones and fresh fruity notes. Orange, bergamot and plum harmonise in the top note. listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Les Parfums Matières Eau de Parfum Spray Fleur de Thé 50 ml
listings.description: With the Les Parfums Matières line, Karl Lagerfeld has dedicated himself to reinterpreting the essential fragrance notes of haute parfumerie. Fleur de Thé Eau de Parfum Spray focuses on a harmonious combination of citrus freshness and floral elements. The opening is sparkling with an interplay of mandarin, lemon and neroli. These bright nuances lead into a heart characterised by the eponymous note of green tea. The central tea accord is complemented by floral facets of Sambac jasmine and camellia blossom, which lend the composition an elegant depth. The base note forms a gentle contrast to the initial freshness, with light woods, musk and amber providing a warm finish. Visually, the transparent glass bottle with its turquoise-coloured liquid underlines the clear character of the fragrance. The design remains minimalist and timeless. listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Karl Eau de Toilette Spray Vienna Opéra 60 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the city of Vienna, Karl Lagerfeld presents a charming men's fragrance with woody and spicy notes . The potpourri from the Karl collection invites you to take a trip to the Vienna Opera House, which is exactly why it bears this name: Vienna Opéra! The eau de toilette spray entices you to take a sensual break from everyday life, even on occasions other than an event at the theatre. Opera feelings like in Vienna Let fragrances by Karl Lagerfeld whisk you away to distant worlds; this time to the vibrant capital of Austria. Vienna is characterised by pure elegance and artistic flair . The Vienna Opéra fragrance by Karl Lagerfeld skilfully captures both. The fragrance from the Karl collection opens with a mix of fruity grapefruit, spicy basil and black pepper that tickles the nose. The seductive art of the men's fragrance then culminates in the heart note of gentle sage, garnished with lavender and a hint of apple. In the base, warm scents such as vetiver, sandalwood and cedarwood bring you back to the here and now and provide a classic finish to the Vienna Opéra Eau de Toilette Spray. Become a star in your life with just a few spritzes of the eau de toilette spray!

listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Les Parfums Matières Eau de Parfum Spray Fleur de Pivoine 50 ml
listings.description: As part of the Les Parfums Matières collection, Karl Lagerfeld interprets the peony as the central element of a floral-fruity composition with Fleur de Pivoine. The Eau de Parfum Spray opens with a clear top note that combines the sparkling freshness of mandarin with the fine acidity of redcurrant and green accords. This invigorating start flows smoothly into a velvety heart that focuses on the eponymous blossom. A bouquet of peony, jasmine and lily of the valley creates a delicate, floral depth that always remains transparent and light. To give the fragrance stability and warmth, a combination of white cedar and amber was chosen for the base, which gently rounds off and grounds the floral notes. The design of the bottle also reflects the characteristics of the fragrance: The glass is translucent, revealing the pink liquid inside, while the transparent cap features a colour-coordinated insert. Packaged in a white case with a leather look, the product emphasises a modern, purist aesthetic that focuses on the essentials. Fragrance family: Floral-fruity with an accentuated peony note Top note: Combination of mandarin, redcurrant and green notes Heart note: Floral bouquet of peony, jasmine and lily of the valley Base note: Warm finish with white cedar and amber Design: Translucent bottle with pink-coloured liquid and matching lid insert

listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Les Parfums Matières Eau de Toilette Spray Bois de Cyprès 50 ml
listings.description: The Karl Lagerfeld Bois de Cyprès Eau de Toilette Spray comes from the versatile Les Parfums Matières collection. It is a charming men's fragrance that delights as a perfume with spicy and fruity elements . There is also a hint of flowers, which lends a certain lightness to the whole. Scented highlights: Fruits, spices and more Welcome the intense top note of the Bois de Cyprès Eau de Toilette spray by Karl Lagerfeld and discover accords such as mandarin and lemon that put you in a good mood. Add to this the pleasant spiciness of cardamom; slightly exotic and a perfect match for the fruity duo. The heart note is also based on three accords. It blends mint with cypress and lavender, which creates a floral but never overpowering character. In the base, the Karl Lagerfeld brand relies on classic men's fragrances such as vetiver, sage and warm cashmere wood to create a sensual, masculine finish.
