listings.description: The Green Tea Eau Parfumée Scent Spray by Elizabeth Arden is a composition that has been appreciated for its refreshing and light nature since its launch in 1999. Created by perfumer Francis Kurkdjian, this fragrance exudes an aura of carefree energy. It opens with a sparkling wave of citrus notes such as bergamot, lemon and orange peel, accompanied by fruity rhubarb and a hint of caraway. At the heart of the composition is the eponymous green tea, which blends harmoniously with cool peppermint and delicate jasmine. Subtle accents of fennel, clove and celery spices lend the fragrance an interesting complexity. The finish is gentle and persistent with a base of warm amber, earthy oakmoss and a subtle hint of musk. A light and sparkling fragrance for women. Combines aromatic notes of green tea with fresh citrus accords. Created in 1999 by perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. A base of amber, oakmoss and musk provides a gentle finish.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The White Tea Eau de Parfum by Elizabeth Arden is a finely crafted composition that combines floral freshness with woody warmth. It opens with sparkling notes of Italian mandarin and clary sage, which are given a clear lightness by a maritime touch. At the heart of the creation is a present white tea accord that blends harmoniously with the richness of mate absolute, delicate jasmine petals and a subtle rose water. The base of sun-dried tonka bean, a trio of musks and warm amberwood gives the fragrance a gentle depth and ensures a long-lasting, pleasant finish. Developed using VivaScentz™ technology, the individual notes are brought into a particularly balanced relationship. With its elegant and unobtrusive character, this fragrance proves to be a versatile companion for a wide variety of occasions. The minimalist, linear design of the bottle with its satin finish and gold-coloured cap emphasises the pure character of the perfume. listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The White Tea Eau de Toilette Spray by Elizabeth Arden is a woody-floral composition that is characterised by its clear yet multi-layered elegance. It opens with an invigorating blend of sparkling Italian mandarin and the herbal essence of clary sage. A sensual sea breeze accord and the green note of Japanese white fern give the top note a special freshness. At the heart of the fragrance, the eponymous white tea extract unfolds, accompanied by mate absolute from Paraguay and a graceful accord of white iris. Facets of Turkish rose and the warm, nutty nuance of paradise nut add a subtle depth. The base note anchors the composition with a warm and velvety melange. Madras wood, ambrette seed and Venezuelan tonka bean combine with Ambermax® and a harmonious musk triad to create a long-lasting finish. listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau de Toilette Spray Gingerlily 50 ml
listings.description: The Elizabeth Arden White Tea Ginger Lily Eau de Toilette Spray combines floral warmth with a spicy dynamic to create a multi-layered composition. The top note opens with an invigorating blend of sparkling bitter orange, bergamot and mandarin, which is complemented by the subtle nuances of neroli. The fragrance is presented in an elegant, rectangular glass bottle whose clean lines are emphasised by a white, square cap and a golden ring. The red lettering "GINGER LILY" on the front adds a visual accent to the transparent glass. Due to its concentration as an eau de toilette, the spray is ideal for everyday use as it has a pleasant presence without being heavy. Customised fragrances can also be created by layering the spray with other fragrances from the White Tea collection as desired. Fragrance family: Warm spicy and floral notes with musky accents. listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau de Toilette Spray Wild Rose 30 ml
listings.description: The name Elizabeth Arden stands for high-quality and luxurious cosmetics that are popular all over the world. Her name was Florence Nightingale Graham and she was the daughter of Scottish-English immigrants. She spent her youth in poor circumstances in the Canadian province of Ontario. She moved to New York in 1908 and opened her beauty parlour on Fifth Avenue with a business partner in 1910, where she became very successful. Initially she sold toners and creams, which she soon had created by the company's own chemists. She developed her own range of products. As a result, her customer base and the popularity of her products continued to grow. After Elizabeth Arden's death in 1966, the company was initially sold to several groups. Since 2003, the Elizabeth Arden Group has belonged to FFI Fragrances, a US company that now operates under the name Elizabeth Arden Inc. The White Tea Wild Rose fragrance is available as an eau de toilette spray The White Tea Wild Rose eau de toilette spray is available in a practical fragrance diffuser. Enjoy these wonderful scents of white tea and wild rose. A subtle note of madras wood, ambrette seed absolute and musk lend the White Tea Wild Rose Eau de Toilette Spray its subtle sensuality. Let this incredibly feminine fragrance work its magic on your senses.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez NARCISO Eau de Parfum Spray Poudrée 30 ml
listings.description: The NARCISOPoudrée Eau de Parfum Spray by Narciso Rodriguez is a tribute to feminine elegance. Created in 2016 by perfumer Aurelien Guichard, the composition opens with a delicate bouquet of Bulgarian rose, Sambac jasmine and orange blossom. The characteristic musk unfolds at the heart of the fragrance, giving the perfume its unmistakable warmth and depth. This central note is supported by a base of woody accents such as vetiver and cedar, which is subtly complemented by coumarin and patchouli. The interplay of these elements creates a soft, powdery fragrance that creates a soft yet sophisticated aura. As part of the iconic NARCISO collection, the perfume has a lasting, finely tuned presence. The minimalist design of the bottle emphasises the timeless character of the creation with its clean lines. Powdery-floral fragrance character with musk at the heart. Composition of Bulgarian rose, jasmine, vetiver and cedar. A soft, feminine fragrance that epitomises sensual elegance. Presented in a minimalist bottle with clean lines.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez for her Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The for her Eau de Parfum Spray by Narciso Rodriguez is an elegant fragrance composition that unfolds around a warm heart of musk. As a more intense interpretation of the original eau de toilette, this fragrance was created in 2004 by the renowned perfumers Christine Nagel and Francis Kurkdjian. The central musky note is caressed by delicate floral accents of rose and the fruity sweetness of peach. This harmonious combination lends the perfume a graceful lightness and feminine radiance. In the base, warm notes of amber and earthy patchouli ensure a long-lasting depth and unforgettable sillage. The fragrance family can be described as floral, with the characteristic musky accord always taking centre stage and giving the perfume its modern yet timeless signature. A floral fragrance with a central, warm musk accord. Combines floral notes of rose with peach, amber and patchouli. A more intense composition than the original eau de toilette. Created by perfumers Christine Nagel and Francis Kurkdjian.

listings.description: NARCISOCristal by Narciso Rodriguez is a tribute to femininity and its natural radiance, captured in a luminous, floral-woody fragrance. Launched in 2022, the composition celebrates inner luminosity, comparable to the multi-faceted reflections of a crystal. The fragrance opens with a fresh combination of sparkling bergamot, delicate freesia and orange blossom, which gently fades into a floral heart. With around 85% of ingredients of natural origin, the result is an eau de parfum that leaves an unforgettable aura. listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez for him Eau de Toilette Spray Vetiver Musc 50 ml
listings.description: The For Him Vetiver Musc Eau de Toilette Spray by Narciso Rodriguez is a woody, aromatic fragrance creation. It begins with an invigorating top note, in which the spicy facets of juniper, cardamom and nutmeg interact and create a striking first impression. The heart of the fragrance then unfolds, characterised by the unmistakable musk note. This central component is harmoniously surrounded by bourbon geranium, lavender and the nuances of red algae and incense, which lend the fragrance a special complexity. The base note rounds off the olfactory experience. Here, earthy vetiver notes combine with warm patchouli and clear cedarwood to create a harmonious finish. The vegan formulation of the eau de toilette is presented in a bottle with a minimalist and modern design that emphasises the brand's aesthetics. A fragrance from the woody-aromatic fragrance family. Composition of cardamom, characteristic musk and earthy vetiver. The product is available as an eau de toilette. It has a vegan formulation.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez for him Parfum Bleu Noir 50 ml
listings.description: Narciso Rodriguez for him Bleu Noir perfume is a composition that exudes a mysterious and intense aura. Created by master perfumer Sonia Constant, a multi-layered fragrance experience unfolds. It opens with an invigorating blend of cardamom, cypress, bergamot and mandarin. In the heart of the composition, the powdery elegance of iris is combined with musk and a hint of suede, giving the fragrance a special depth. The base is long-lasting and striking, characterised by notes such as tonka bean, sandalwood, leather, vetiver and Atlas cedar. As a perfume version, this fragrance stands out with its intense, leathery facets and has a cooler, smokier base than other variants in the line. The design of the bottle, with its translucent blue glass and matte navy blue cap, visually captures the elegant nature of the fragrance. listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez all of me Eau de Parfum Spray Floral 30 ml
listings.description: The all of me Floral Eau de Parfum Spray by Narciso Rodriguez is an intensely floral and warm composition and a new interpretation of the well-known "all of me" signature. The fragrance initially unfolds with a fresh top note of a tangy lychee accord. At the heart of the creation is a luminous bouquet that combines the essences of geranium bourbon with delicate floral blossoms. An amber-musk heart, complemented by the warmth of guaiac wood essence, provides a sensual and long-lasting base. Developed by perfumers Dora Baghriche and Daphné Bugey, this fragrance consists of 90% ingredients of natural origin and is also vegan-certified. The design of the bottle picks up on the floral theme: A pink colour gradient from matt to transparent reveals the peach-coloured perfume inside. The bottle itself is made from 15% recycled glass. listings.rawTitle: Marbert Man Classic Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: A distinctive, spicy aura surrounds Marbert Man Classic Eau de Toilette Spray, which is characterised by a warm and aromatic composition. The opening notes present herbal accords of wormwood and lavender, which gently transition into a complex heart note where spicy facets of juniper and cinnamon blend with a subtle hint of honey. In the base, elements such as cedarwood, patchouli and amber provide a lasting, woody finish, complemented by hints of leather and moss. This harmonious blend of freshness and warmth makes the fragrance a perfect companion, particularly during the cooler autumn months. As an Eau de Toilette, this fragrance has a concentration of fragrance oils between 6 and 12 per cent, offering a balanced intensity for everyday use without feeling as heavy as an Eau de Parfum. Visually, the product is presented in a rectangular glass bottle with rounded edges, which reveals the pale yellow liquid and is topped with a black, cylindrical cap and a matching label with white lettering.
